jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**A path for every ambition.**

At HUB, we believe the best work happens when people are given real space to grow and then given the autonomy to exercise it. We power progress and protect ambition: for the clients who count on us, and equally for the people who make that possible every day.

We’re creative thinkers and determined doers, guided by values that show up in how we work together: with empathy, adaptability, accountability and a genuine commitment to one another’s success. We foster bold ideas, celebrate curiosity and share what we know. Because when people grow, the work they do grows with them.

Our purpose is deeply human: to help people navigate the world on their terms, at their speed, toward their future. We hold that same commitment to the people building careers here.

Whether you’re starting out or leveling up, you’ll find the resources to evolve, the support to take on more and a team ready to back you at every stage.

Your ambition has a home here.

**Summary:**

The Program Coordinator coordinates the Contractor Development and Bonding Program activities in an operations role that performs daily administrative and operational tasks, contract compliance, and customer service. The Program Coordinator helps compile accurate program data, billing, contractor intake, meetings, and contractor support and resources, among other special projects and events. This is a full-time position dedicated to the Regional Contractor Development and Bonding Program.

**Job Requirements:**

Requires effective communication skills and the ability to provide assistance to employees and the general public. Requires the ability to speak clearly, distinctly and effectively with fellow employees; read in English and compare similarities and differences between words and series of numbers; apply common sense understanding to work processes, procedures, programs and services; and provide and follow verbal and written instructions. Team player with the ability to work in a cross-functional team environment.

  

* Answer phones and perform data entry
* Process new enrollment forms – input enrollment details into the database for each contractor
* Verify certification status and upload records to the database
* Assign and track assigned contractors
* Monitor live prospects to ensure initial contact and follow-up
* Conduct quarterly audits in the database
* Update California State License Board and Department of Industrial Relations records
* Update contractors’ business information (email, phone number, etc.)
* FA 206 – work with the Program Marketing Coordinator to manage the calendar and event tracking database
* Assist with event registration – enter, update and manage
* Request and file monthly reports (Funds Control, Contractor Status Report, Principal Status Report, etc.)
* Work with the Field Support Project Manager to input information into the database and follow up with General Contractors or agency representatives to clarify discrepancies
* Update and submit reports for billing (Task Sheet Reports, KPI reporting, Program Totals) and annual reports
* Assist the Account Manager with updating contractor profiles, meeting agendas and minutes (MM, Team, Bond Dept.)
* Serve as a team member on the internal communication team (Employee Communication) – format LA Contractor Weekly (LACW) content and material for publication and distribution
* Assist with social media efforts
* Manage expense reporting, ensuring all program receipts and invoices are collected
* Provide additional office support: mailing, checking mail, floor warden duties, ordering office supplies
* Verify program resources and keep them updated
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:**

  

* Knowledge of the sectors involved in public contracting and procurement (small business, community organizations, cities and government)
* Knowledge of Diversity, Equity & Inclusion principles and practices is a plus

**Compensation & Benefits**

The expected salary range for this position is $30.00 to $36.00 per hour, depending on experience, and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate’s skills and experience, working location, and the specific position’s business line, scope and level.

**What we offer you**

We invest in your growth. HUB offers structured training, licensing support, and ongoing development opportunities designed to accelerate your career. Benefits and programs vary based on employment status, role, location, and applicable eligibility requirements.

  

* Competitive pay with comprehensive health benefits, retirement savings matching, and company-paid life and disability plans
* Generous paid time off, paid parental leave and a wellbeing program designed to support real work/life balance
* A collaborative, high-performing culture with meaningful engagement, community impact through HUB Gives and genuine room to grow your career

**The HUB difference**

HUB International is one of North America’s largest insurance brokers, delivering risk management, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management solutions to businesses and individuals across the United States and Canada — through locally led teams backed by national expertise, giving you the agility of a local partner and the reach of a global organization.

jobs.description:
Are you a person who enjoys helping others? Are you currently seeking fulfillment in your professional life?

  

Hope Services is Silicon Valley’s leading provider of services to people with developmental disabilities and mental health needs. We seek candidates who share our inspirations & aspirations. Selection of staff is made on a competitive basis, and we are committed to promoting diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging at all levels..

**>>>>> 2025 Winner of Mercury News Best in Silicon Valley** **<<<<<**

**>>>>> ASPIRE to Excellence CARF Accredited** **<<<<<**

**>>>>> 2024 Great Nonprofits Top-Rated Nonprofit** **<<<<<**

**>>>>> Four-star Charity Navigator** **<<<<<**

**>>>>> 2024 Candid Gold Seal of Transparency** **<<<<<**

* **Compensation****: $5,859.00 per month**

**Purpose:**

Provides resources support and training to staff and clients to facilitate agency, program, and consumer goals. Supervision, hiring and training staff, budgeting and contract fulfillment, and assignments to perform or discharge special projects in areas of responsibility. Ensures maintenance of equipment, ordering of supplies, inventory and quality of service.

**Principle Responsibilities:**

The following responsibilities represent the essential functions of the position. An employee in this classification is responsible for carrying out the following functions:

1. Assures adequate program staffing through scheduling, recruitment, hiring,

and orientation of direct service, substitute and volunteer staff as assigned.

Provides all aspects of supervision, evaluation, and training of staff.

2. Acts as a resource for rehabilitation, program development, community

based employment and activities, acts as a liaison between program

services and the community.

3. Provides oversight of daily operations and services including case

management, communications, and advocacy, assures quality services are

provided in timely manner.

4. Assures timely communications with persons served, families, care

providers, funding sources, staff, management and community.

5. Participates in the development and implementation of the Agency planning

effort including departmental budgeting, policies and procedures, and the

implementation of Agency goals.

6. Oversees accuracy and timeliness of billing, payroll, funding, DOL

compliance, inventories, training records, and various internal and external

reports.

7. Conducts tours, presentations and client intakes.

8. Assures compliance with all safety regulations.

9. In the absence of a manager, if assigned, may act in that capacity.

10. Provides direct service in program operations as needed to assure adequate

staffing ratios.

11. Acts as a mandated abuse reporter.

12. May perform special projects or other duties as assigned to assure the

efficiency of the program.

**Minimum Qualifications**:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent plus three years of related experience working with people with disabilities in a rehabilitation environment.

**Reports To:** Manager

**Supervisory Responsibility****:** yes

**Required knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

1. Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, database and spreadsheet

2. Ability to communicate effectively and provide excellent customer service

3. Ability to facilitate systems and checks to assure delivery of quality service

and product to internal and external customers

4. Knowledge of the principles of management, supervision, planning, fiscal

management, fair employment practices, regulations, safety, health and

client rights

5. Ability to observe, evaluate, document and communicate verbally and in

writing

6. Knowledge of rehabilitation and program development

**Environmental Conditions:**

Constant movement around service area, and travel into the community. Time spent sitting, using a computer station, periods of intense concentration, using the telephone, paperwork. Time spent in meetings, travel to various work site locations throughout three counties. Exposure to outdoor weather and environmental conditions.

Positions connected to a production environment are also exposed to times of fast paced activity, loud noise and to dust and airborne particles.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.description:
**About Bill Wilson Center:**  
Bill Wilson Center provides services to children, youth, young adults, and families in Santa Clara County. Additionally, we reach clients through our street outreach and crisis line programs. Bill Wilson Center programs focus on housing, mental health care, supportive services, and advocacy. Bill Wilson Center is committed to working with the community to ensure that every youth has access to the range of services needed to grow to be healthy and self-sufficient adults. A key component of Bill Wilson Center's philosophy encompasses a strength-based approach to improving the lives of the youth and young families in our communities. Bill Wilson Center has been providing services to runaway and homeless youth since 1973. Join us and become a difference maker at Bill Wilson Center!

**Job Summary:**  
In partnership with County of Santa Clara, Bill Wilson Center provides independent living skills and basic needs for foster youth. The HUB Coordinator welcomes and greets youth and provides orientation of facilities and services. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform all essential duties and responsibilities satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Essential Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate with the Hub/ILP Program Manager (PM) to ensure the opening and closing of the HUB and appropriate in-person coverage at the front desk. Provide copies of sign in sheets to the PM as requested.
* Assist staff to verify client eligibility.
* Ensure that client and program records are maintained and up to date, ensure data entry is timely in Efforts to Outcomes (ETO) database as required.
* Provide reports as required to track client participation in services.
* Plan, coordinate and facilitate meetings, workshops and events. Create flyers and outreach messaging as necessary.
* Coordinate the daily monitoring and maintenance of basic services such as kitchen, showers, washers/dryers, and HUB Mart.
* Provide orientation and tours to clients, visitors and other stakeholders.
* Provide peer support to HUB members. Responsible for supervising clients on the HUB floor and ensuring rules and policies are being observed. Issue consequences to clients for violations and report incidents to the program manager immediately. Work cooperatively with all co-located partners to ensure safety of the HUB and adherence to all procedures.
* Mediate client concerns and conflict following applicable policies and procedures.
* Participate in outreach by text, phone, email and/or social media to engage them in services.
* Participate in administering and maintaining HUB Instagram, web site, and other social media accounts as directed.
* Responsible for soliciting food and HUB Mart donations. Coordinate with the Development Department to solicit monetary donations.
* Responsible for supplies inventory, management and ordering.
* Responsible for arranging meeting room requests.
* Provides transportation and/or coordinates client transportation HUB/ILP events.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree plus 2 years of comparable work experience. Experience working with foster care system, probation and/or transition age clients, or personal experience in the above. Experience working with culturally diverse clients required. Knowledge of local Child Welfare and Juvenile Probation policies, procedures and governing legislation preferred, but not required.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Driving is a requirement of the job. Must have possession of current driver’s license, access to a vehicle and personal automobile insurance. Carry a valid driver’s license, copy of vehicle registration, and Insurance in the event that coordinator needs to pick-up food donation, buying
* general food/supplies, and transporting clients.
* Current CPR and First Aid Certification required (or complete within 30 days of hire).
* Fingerprinting/background check as required by the Department of Justice and/or Title XXII regulations. TB test required.
* Must be punctual, efficient and organized; effective and professional under pressure. Ability to balance excellent client care with meeting deadlines and ensuring positive program goals and outcomes. Excellent communication skills - must be personable and informative when presenting
* Bill Wilson Center programs and services.
* Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Must be able to communicate effectively. Bilingual communication skills are a plus.
* Ability to work with basic mathematical concepts as required for reporting.
* Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
* To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of Internet software; spreadsheet software and word processing software and Internet research skills.

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to move and remain stationary, communicate, gather information and record information.
* The employee must occasionally move up to 20 pounds

jobs.title: Program Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Covenant House California (CHC) is a nonprofit organization that provides sanctuary and support for youth overcoming homelessness, ages 18-24. CHC believes that no young person deserves to be homeless; that every young person in California deserves housing, food, clothing, education, and most importantly, to be loved. CHC provides a full continuum of services to meet the physical, emotional, educational, vocational, and spiritual well-being of young people.

CHC’s doors are open to youth and staff regardless of their race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We believe that youth and team members deserve to be in an environment that is inclusive and affirming; where everyone is treated with dignity and respect and valued and appreciated for who they are. Maintaining a diverse community of youth and staff is key to our ability to achieve our mission most effectively. We are also committed to being a leader in advancing anti-racism, and to promoting opportunities for the free expression of the lived experiences of our youth and staff.

We are looking for people who, like us, believe that every young person deserves a place to belong. We think it takes all kinds of people to create diverse solutions to end youth homelessness and we are on a committed journey to build an inclusive and equitable work culture that brings out the best in everyone.

Covenant House California offers an excellent benefits package, (most benefits effective date of hire), including medical, vision, dental, an EAP program, 403b retirement account, and a generous vacation package.

**Position Summary**

The Program Project Coordinator provides high-level administrative and programmatic support directly to the Chief Program Officer (CPO), helping manage the CPO’s calendar, communications, and day-to-day priorities so the CPO can focus on leading the Program Division effectively. This role will also support the Norcal and Socal SVP’s with special projects, policy/procedures and any duties as assigned to help strengthen program operations and consistency across the state.

This role blends traditional administrative program responsibilities – calendar management, meeting logistics, audit preparations, meeting note compilation and travel coordination – with ownership of special program related project assignments given directly by the CPO. The right person is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable anticipating CPO and SVP’s needs before being asked. They work behind the scenes to keep information flowing, fill various gaps needing administrative support, keep deadlines on track, and the CPO prepared for every meeting – including supporting the tracking of trainings, professional development logistics, and other administrative systems that keep the Program Division organized and unified.

The ideal candidate brings strong administrative and project coordination experience, sound judgment, a passion for serving young people experiencing homelessness and the discretion needed to support a busy executive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

**What Success Looks Like**

* In the first 90 days, the Program Project Coordinator will:
* Complete onboarding, including learning CHC’s program structure and meeting the Program Leadership team
* Take over calendar, scheduling, and meeting coordination for the CPO
* Establish organized tracking systems for the CPO and SVP’s special projects, trainings, and meeting follow-ups
* Build a clear working rhythm and communication style with the CPO

**By the end of year one, the Program Project Coordinator will have:**

* Become the CPO’s trusted, go-to resource for scheduling, logistics, and administrative coordination
* Successfully managed several special program related project assignments from start to finish
* Built reliable systems for tracking trainings, onboarding logistics, and program documentation
* Earned the CPO’s confidence as someone who keeps things organized and follows through

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Executive & Calendar Support**

* Manage the CPO’s scheduling, calendar coordination, travel planning, and related logistics, support SVP’s administrative needs as well.
* Coordinate logistics for meetings the CPO leads or attends, including agendas, preparation, action items and follow-ups
* Draft power point presentations, briefing documents, and talking points as directed by the CPO
* Organize and maintain the CPO’s SharePoint folders and internal filing systems

**Special Projects:**

* Own and run special project assignments that are program focused given directly by the CPO, from planning through completion
* Coordinate logistics for the CPO’s tours, speaking engagements, and site visits, including pre-event preparation and follow-up
* Track action items and deadlines on the CPO’s behalf to keep cross-department work moving forward
* Assist the CPO with grant and funder reporting by gathering information and compiling draft materials in collaboration with the Development team

**Training & Program Documentation Support:**

* Maintain tracking tools and attendance systems that support the professional development and training function, at the CPO’s direction and in partnership with the Senior Director of Program Training & Professional Development
* Support onboarding logistics for new program leaders, including scheduling, materials, and checklists
* Help maintain and distribute policy and procedure updates, including notes and follow-ups from relevant Covenant House International (CHI) calls(SCPO Calls, Presidium checklist, Quarterly Data review calls)
* Maintain internal tracking and reporting tools the CPO uses to keep the division organized

**Meeting & Communications Support:**

* Prepare meeting materials, one-pagers, and presentation decks as directed by the CPO
* Take notes and minutes at meetings the CPO attends and distribute follow-up items
* Serve as a point of contact for internal and external inquiri

jobs.description:
Position Information

**Job Title**

Program Coordinator - CalWORKs

  

**Position Type**

Classified

  

**Position Code**

3CCW02

  

**FTE**

1

  

**Pay Rate (or Annual Salary)**

$6,665.92 - $7,006.42/month

  

**Job Location**

Las Positas College, 3000 Campus Hill Dr., Livermore, CA 94551

  

**Department**

Special Programs

  

**Job Summary**

**Las Positas College**  
Las Positas College provides an inclusive, learning-centered, equity-focused environment that offers educational opportunities and support for completion of students’ transfer, degree, and career-technical goals while promoting lifelong learning. At Las Positas College we know that equity will be achieved by changing the impacts of structural racism, ableism, homophobia, and systematic poverty on student success and access to higher education, achieved through continuous evaluation and improvement of all services. We believe in a high-quality education focused on learning and an inclusive, culturally-relevant environment that meets the diverse needs of all our students and staff.
  
  
Equity is parity in student educational outcomes; it places belonging for students of color and disproportionately impacted students at center focus. Our prized and emerging equity efforts include Puente, Umoja, ConnectUp, Brother 2 Brother, Sister 2 Sister, Black Student Union, Presidential Task Force on Systemic and Institutionalized Racism, the Presidential Speaker Series, Black Education Association, UndocuAlly Taskforce, curriculum reviews and a linguistic justice curriculum.  
  
Located in Livermore, Las Positas College is becoming an institution that reflects the diversity in California. We are a learning-centered institution focused on excellence and student success, and are fully committed to supporting all Tri-Valley residents in their quest for education and advancement.  
  
**Joining Our College Community**  
We seek equity-minded applicants who demonstrate they understand the benefits diversity brings to an educational community. We look for applicants who:Value and intentionally promote diversity and consciousness of differenceDemonstrate cultural humility and an ongoing desire to improve cultural competenceAre dedicated to addressing issues of social justiceAccept their shared role and responsibility in addressing opportunity and achievement gaps experienced by studentsHave experience and success in closing student equity gaps and engaging in equitable practices, or are knowledgeable and enthusiastic about implementing practices that achieve these goalsActively seek to identify, disrupt, and remove institutional and/or systemic barriers that adversely impact historically marginalized communitiesEmpower the underrepresented and underservedFoster students’ potential to become global citizens and socially responsible leadersBelieve that all people have the right to an education and work environment free from fear, harassment, or discrimination.  
  
The Chabot-Las Positas Community College District is seeking to fill a Program Coordinator – CalWORKs position for Las Positas College in Livermore, California.  
  
**SUMMARY****DESCRIPTION**  
Under direction, oversee and coordinate the day-to-day operations of the CalWORKs program including performing a variety of para-professional, technical, administrative, and complex office support work related to enhancing services for students including CalWORKs, foster youth, and students who are homeless or at-risk of becoming homeless; assume responsibility for program coordination, implementation, outreach, monitoring, tracking, and reporting; establish and monitor program budgets; coordinate with administration, faculty, staff, and community members to enlist support, cooperation, and participation in appropriate activities related to assigned program(s); and serves as a resource and liaison for students including CalWORKs, foster youth, and students who are homeless or at-risk of becoming homeless.  
  
This is a grant/categorically funded position. Continuation of this position is contingent upon available funding on a year to year basis.

  

**Representative Duties**

The following duties are typical for this classification. Incumbents may not perform all of the listed duties and/or may be required to perform additional or different duties from those set forth below to address business needs and changing business practices.  
  
1. Coordinate the daily services and activities of the CalWORKs program and activities related to foster youth and students who are homeless or at-risk of becoming homeless.  
  
2. Develop the CalWORKs program plan and budget; coordinate budget planning activities and monitor expenditures; prepare monthly budget reports and year-end accountability report; serve as a liaison for both internal and external departments and agencies.  
  
3. Develop, recommend, and implement program plans and objectives; coordinate delivery of service to program participants; ensure participation guidelines are followed.  
  
4. Ensure program expenditures are within allocated budgets and program activities comply with program standards, the CalWORKs Program Plan, and compliance requirements; research potential programs/grants for foster youth and students who are homeless or at-risk of becoming homeless.  
  
5. Conduct intake and orientation to incoming students; determine students’ eligibility for the program; conduct needs assessments; refer students to appropriate resources.  
  
6. Coordinate child care component of program including eligibility and expenditure of funds.  
  
7. Maintain records of student program completion and job attainment.  
  
8. Coordinate with staff in designing and implementing recruitment strategies to support program goals and objectives and to strengthen collaboration with other programs.  
  
9. Provide orientation and training to new employees when assigned; assign, schedule, train, and provide work direction to office staff

**Description of Department**

The **Contact Center** is a centralized call center supporting multiple specialties to better serve our patients. Our vision is to develop a team of highly trained experts who support one or more specialties.

Practice Coordinators are responsible for scheduling new and follow-up patient appointments and processing incoming and internal referrals.

**Required Qualifications**

* High School graduate or equivalent with four years related experience; or college degree and 6 months related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Successfully passes fingerprinting protocol and is approved to be a cash collector if applicable.
* Strong computer skills, including basic keyboarding skills, and experience with at least two Office-type software programs (i.e., Outlook, Word and Excel). Proven ability to navigate through multiple patient records systems. Able to sit at a computer terminal with telephone headphones for extended period of time.
* Ability to analyze situations, prioritizes, and develops solutions and makes recommendations.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision
* Ability to use good judgment and work independently, at times under the pressure of deadlines
* Ability to access situations prioritizes workload, develop solutions and make recommendations.
* Excellent customer service and communication/interpersonal skills, both over the telephone and directly.
* Able to sit at a computer terminal with telephone headphones for extended periods of time.
* Basic math skills required.
* Proven ability to deal with a wide variety of individuals;
* Ability to deal sensitively and effectively with patients.
* Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.
* Strong writing skills to include the ability to compose, edit, and proof a wide variety of documents.
* Demonstrated administrative/office coordination skills.
* Demonstrated knowledge of medical practice terminology.
* Within six months of start date, based upon completion of training, the Supervisor, completes the proficiency checklist with the employee. This includes the following areas if applicable: Referrals (Incoming referral entry) and handling all referral WQs Schedule surgeries, Work applicable work queues, Enter/edit outside test results, Messaging (CRM) if applicable, 2nd calls in CRM if applicable, Telephone encounters, My open encounter, Staff message, New message, Route Patient advice request to providers (My Chart), Patient Schedule (My Chart), Letters, Pools, Patient look up, Check in process, Check out process, Comment field, Quick note, Scanning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience in health care (may include medical, dental or veterinary) in the following areas: patient scheduling, insurance verification, medical record data abstraction, or patient financial services.
* Prior experience with appointment, ancillary service or surgical scheduling or a combination of all three.
* Prior experience with EPIC.

**Training & Work Arrangement**

Initial training is **onsite for a minimum of 16 weeks, Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.** Training will take place at UCSF locations in **Emeryville, Brisbane, or San Francisco**, depending on available training resources.

Practice Coordinators may work onsite at any or all UCSF locations as needed for training and other business-related purposes – at Brisbane at 8000 Marina Blvd, Emeryville at 6425 Christie Avenue and in San Francisco. The parking is free at our Brisbane and Emeryville locations; however, most San Francisco locations do not have free parking

Onsite training may be extended if department performance metrics are not met. After successful completion of training, the position will transition to a combination of onsite and remote work. **Onsite expectations remain flexible and are subject to change based on operational needs.**

Pay: $36.03 - $51.06 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Application Question(s):

**Who we are**

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We're changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don't just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

  

**About the role**

The **Operations Manager** will serve as the end-to-end owner of market operations, responsible for leading a high-performing team, delivering on key performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement. This role is ideal for a high-agency operator who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves to solve problems from first principles.

You will lead day-to-day execution while identifying opportunities to scale processes, improve efficiency, and enhance the driver and passenger experience. Success in this role requires a strong drive for action, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to develop talent while holding teams accountable to results. This is a critical leadership role with direct impact on Atoms's growth and operational excellence.

  

**What you'll do**

* **Own and drive the end-to-end operations of your depot –** you are the leader of your business, responsible for performance and execution exceeding performance metric goals.
* **Own costs, and performance management** across all ops team members, ensuring a lean, high-output team.
* **Own all aspects of fleet operations –** from vehicle health and availability to onboarding ensuring maximum uptime and reducing unnecessary downtime.
* **Lead with data**: Solve real-world problems using first-principles, taking an analytical approach to delivering results.
* **Inspire and develop** high-performing teams through coaching, feedback, and clear accountability; build future leaders by fostering ownership at all levels.
* **Identify and own high-impact projects** that move the needle on efficiency, scalability, and customer experience—then drive them from ideation through execution.
* **Foster a culture of bias for action** and operational excellence, where problems are surfaced early and solved quickly.
* **Continuously challenge the status quo**: Look for opportunities to automate, streamline, or rethink legacy processes to scale faster and better.
* **Develop deep understanding of business needs** – to serve as the connective tissue across departments, ensuring alignment, communication, and accountability from strategy through frontline execution.
* **Relentlessly pursue operational improvement**, leveraging data and feedback loops to refine the market's roadmap and deliver exceptional results.

  

**What we're looking for**

* **Bachelor's degree in Business Admin, Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering,** or a related field.
* **5+ years of experience** in operations, logistics, or fleet-based startups where you owned execution, solved problems from first principles, and managed performance in fast-paced environments.
* **3+ years of direct people leadership experience,** including hiring, coaching, and holding teams accountable to outcomes in hourly or shift-based workforces.
* **Proven experience managing fleet operations**, with a focus on maximizing vehicle uptime, utilization, and operational efficiency.
* **Strong analytical skill set**, with the ability to use data to identify bottlenecks, prioritize high-impact initiatives, and drive continuous improvement
* **Exceptional communicator**, capable of aligning field teams and HQ stakeholders through clear, concise written and verbal updates
* **Builder mindset** with product orientation, eager to create systems, improve workflows, and collaborate with tech teams to influence tools and process design
* **Self-directed operator with a high sense of ownership**, who thrives in ambiguity and moves quickly from insight to action

  

**Why join us**

At Atoms, you'll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what's known and building what doesn't yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it's grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow.

  

**What else you need to know**

This role is based in our San Franciscooffice. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change - we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That's why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

Description:

**Position Summary**

The Operations Program Manager (OPM) is responsible for the successful execution of assigned customer programs and manufacturing orders from purchase order acceptance through production, final inspection, shipment, and delivery.

As A1J Technologies transitions from a traditional precision machining job shop into a scalable Tier 1 supplier supporting commercial aerospace and defense customers, this position plays a critical role in strengthening program accountability, cross-functional coordination, customer communication, and on-time delivery performance.

The Operations Program Manager serves as the primary internal coordinator for assigned customer programs, ensuring that Engineering, CNC Programming, Master Scheduling, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and Shipping activities are aligned with contractual requirements, approved delivery commitments, and operational priorities.

This position is responsible for maintaining accurate program status, identifying and escalating execution risks, coordinating recovery plans, monitoring program milestones, and ensuring customer commitments are supported by realistic manufacturing schedules and available resources.

The successful candidate must demonstrate strong manufacturing knowledge, program execution discipline, customer communication skills, and the ability to drive accountability across multiple departments without direct functional authority.

**Primary Responsibilities**

### **Customer Program Ownership & Execution**

* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for assigned customer programs and manufacturing orders.
* Maintain end-to-end visibility of assigned jobs from order acceptance through manufacturing, inspection, shipment, and delivery.
* Review customer purchase orders, contractual delivery commitments, program requirements, and critical milestones in coordination with CSR, Sales, Engineering, and Quality.
* Establish program execution plans identifying key deliverables, manufacturing milestones, schedule dependencies, and operational risks.
* Ensure assigned programs are executed in accordance with customer requirements, approved schedules, and applicable quality standards.
* Monitor overall program progress and coordinate cross-functional actions necessary to achieve customer delivery commitments.
* Identify potential delays, resource constraints, and execution issues before they affect customer deliveries.
* Maintain ownership of program-level action items, risk registers, recovery plans, and customer commitments.
* Escalate unresolved issues to Operations leadership with recommended corrective actions.

**2. Program Planning & Manufacturing Readiness**

* Coordinate with Engineering, Process Engineering, CNC Programming, Supply Chain, Quality, and Master Scheduling to ensure jobs are ready for manufacturing.
* Monitor engineering reviews, routing development, traveler preparation, CNC programming, material procurement, tooling availability, and inspection planning.
* Establish and track preproduction milestones to support planned manufacturing start dates.
* Identify incomplete engineering packages, material shortages, programming delays, or unresolved technical requirements.
* Coordinate timely resolution of manufacturing readiness issues with responsible department managers.
* Participate in manufacturing readiness reviews for new, complex, high-priority, or customer-critical programs.
* Ensure customer-driven changes are communicated to affected departments and incorporated into approved program plans.
* Support first-article and new product introduction activities by tracking technical, manufacturing, and quality readiness.

* Maintain visibility of manufacturing progress across machining, outside processing, inspection, and shipping operations.
* Identify jobs at risk of missing planned milestones or customer delivery dates.
* Coordinate cross-functional recovery actions to address delays and restore program execution.
* Evaluate the delivery impact of machine downtime, material shortages, engineering delays, quality issues, and outside processing constraints.
* Support the development of realistic delivery projections based on verified manufacturing status and approved scheduling assumptions.
* Ensure schedule risks and changes are communicated promptly to appropriate stakeholders.
* Do not independently change the master production schedule or direct machine-level priorities outside established Operations approval processes.

* Provide accurate, timely, and professional status updates to customers and internal stakeholders within assigned communication authority.
* Prepare customer program trackers, milestone schedules, delivery recovery plans, and operational progress reports.
* Coordinate with CSR and Sales to ensure customer communications reflect verified manufacturing status and approved commitments.
* Lead or participate in customer program reviews, production status meetings, and delivery recovery discussions.
* Communicate program risks, corrective actions, and anticipated delivery impacts clearly and proactively.
* Maintain documented customer commitments, action items, and follow-up responsibilities.
* Support customer visits, operational reviews, and program execution discussions.
* Ensure delivery commitments and recovery dates are approved by the appropriate Operations and commercial authorities before being communicated externally.

This position manages SFRRN grants and contracts and supports operations across its 8 network partners, while collaborating with community organizations, coalitions, and government agencies. The SFRRN Program Manager also partners closely with the SFILEN Program Manager and supervises the SFILEN & SFRRN Program Coordinator.

### 

### **About Chinese for Affirmative Action (CAA)**

CAA was founded in 1969 to protect the civil and political rights of Chinese Americans and to advance multiracial democracy in the United States. Today, CAA is a progressive voice in and on behalf of the broader Asian American and Pacific Islander community. CAA advocates for systemic change that protects immigrant rights, promotes language diversity, and remedies racial and social injustice.

### 

### **About SF Rapid Response Network (SFRRN)**

The San Francisco Rapid Response Network (SFRRN) is a 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, immigration enforcement response hotline serving the City of San Francisco. Founded in 2008, and revamped in 2016, SFRRN was one of the first, and remains one of the few 24/7 immigration enforcement response hotlines in the country. SFRRN houses 8 immigration focused community based organizations who staff the 24/7 hotline, verifies immigration enforcement activity in San Francisco, connects San Franciscans to legal and accompaniment services, and provides immigration centered Know-Your-Rights education to immigrant community members citywide.

  

In 2026, CAA became the lead and fiscal agency to house the San Francisco Immigrant Legal & Education Network (SFILEN) and SFRRN. jobs.description:

Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive.

We deliver automation through a Robotics-as-a-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full-service support into a single, integrated solution. By removing the traditional barriers of cost, complexity, and risk, we enable manufacturers to deploy automation quickly and realize measurable gains in throughput, safety, and operational efficiency without large upfront capital investment.

The Fleet Operations Team drives uptime and operational performance across Formic's growing fleet of deployed robotic systems. jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Accessibility
jobs.description:
### **About Us**

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

### **About the Role**

As the Senior Program Manager, Accessibility at Twitch, you will have a broad impact across all of Twitch and our Community. Reporting into the VP of UX, you will join our Design team where you will own the program design, education and enablement, and the auditing and testing output. We will look to you to execute the vision of how Twitch will be a welcome home for all regardless of abilities. You will partner with product, design, engineering, and legal to solve accessibility problems at scale and provide strategic solutions.

You can work from Twitch’s headquarters in San Francisco, CA; or from one of our hub locations in Seattle, WA; Los Angeles, CA; Irvine, CA; or New York City, NY - with West Coast (PST) working hours.

### **You Will:**

* **Strategy & SME:** Serve as the subject-matter expert for global digital accessibility across Twitch - advising product and partner teams, and leading process and tooling integration (including AI where appropriate).
* **Operations & Backlog:** Own intake, backlog, and operational management - partnering with engineering, product, and design leaders to prioritize and drive core accessibility issues, with regular communications and reporting.
* **QA & Testing:** Lead QA execution and manage QA specialists and third-party vendors; partner with engineers to build automated accessibility testing into CI/CD pipelines, shifting testing earlier in the development lifecycle.
* **High-impact programs:** Work with engineers, designers, product managers, and researchers to identify and deliver high-impact changes and programs across all products.
* **Partnerships:** Collaborate with accessibility partners (legal, research, policy, communications) on benchmarking, goal-setting, reporting, and execution.
* **Education & Enablement:** Develop an educational program and deploy guidelines and resources for key collaborators.

### **You Have:**

* You have 6+ years experience building similar Accessibility programs, QA and other scalable Accessibility Practices.
* Expertise in accessibility best practices, guidelines, and regulations—specifically WCAG 2.2+ AA and the CVAA; ability to advise the executive team on risk assessment.
* You have experience creating and leading an accessibility program from ground up including creating, documenting, proactive management and driving deliverables.
* Experience working with and consulting product, design, engineering, and legal teams to deliver accessibility audits, code reviews and other advisory services.
* Experience working on consumer product accessibility both on video and communications products and across a variety of devices, such as desktop, smartphone, gaming console, and OTT services.
* Awareness of assistive technologies available to people with disabilities.
* Experience with Figma, Jira and similar relevant product development tools.

### **Bonus Points**

* Understanding of and familiarity with AI tooling and test automations for Accessibility
* Familiarity with Twitch as a user, streamer, or both!

### **Perks**

* Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance
* 401(k)
* Maternity & Parental Leave
* Flexible PTO
* Amazon Employee Discount

This position will work one day per week onsite in San Francisco.

The AI Program Manager serves as an organization-wide expert and strategic advisor leading UCSF’s enterprise AI program across clinical care, research, education, and administrative operations. The incumbent partners with Enterprise AI product, technical, and leadership stakeholders to translate institutional priorities and complex business needs into adoption plans, enablement programs, stakeholder engagement strategies, feedback loops, and sustainable operating practices. The role evaluates organizational readiness, workflows, stakeholder needs, and performance data to identify opportunities that improve institutional effectiveness, workforce experience, quality, and mission outcomes.

The incumbent coordinates the adoption, enablement, communications, stakeholder engagement, value tracking, and operational readiness components of a high-impact portfolio of AI initiatives from intake through implementation, adoption, value realization, and transition to operations. The role supports prioritization and resource planning by preparing analysis, maintaining visibility into progress and risks, facilitating multidisciplinary coordination, and escalating complex or politically sensitive issues for leadership decision-making.

The AI Program Manager leads awareness and adoption of approved AI tools by communicating available capabilities, appropriate use cases, limitations, support resources, and product roadmaps. Working with senior leaders and clinical, research, academic, operational, technology, and risk stakeholders, the incumbent advances responsible AI adoption, informs vendor and product decisions, leads organizational change, and represents UCSF in relevant University and industry forums. The role works in close partnership with Enterprise AI product leadership, who retain accountability for product strategy, platform roadmap, prioritization recommendations, and product/vendor decision-making.

  

**Department Overview**

UCSF Enterprise Information and Analytics (EIA) advances the institution’s data and analytics capabilities in support of patient care, research, education, and administrative operations. EIA develops and maintains enterprise platforms and services that integrate data from across UCSF, promote consistent and trustworthy information, and support informed decision-making. Its portfolio includes enterprise data warehousing and data lakes, data integration, business intelligence, reporting and analytics, data governance, and data catalog services. EIA also establishes the policies, standards, and processes that enable institutional data to be accessed and used responsibly.

Enterprise AI builds on this foundation by delivering secure, scalable, and responsible artificial intelligence capabilities to the UCSF community. The program integrates AI strategy, governance, platforms, portfolio management, adoption, training, communications, and stakeholder engagement. It supports enterprise services such as UCSF ChatGPT Enterprise and the Versa API, providing secure access to generative AI and multiple AI models. In partnership with technology, privacy, security, legal, compliance, clinical, academic, and operational stakeholders, Enterprise AI identifies and prioritizes high-value opportunities, communicates available capabilities and roadmaps, accelerates responsible adoption, and measures institutional value.

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

Elex Solutions builds the electrical infrastructure behind California's electrification push — commercial and multi-family solar, and EV charging. We're hiring a Project Manager / Site Superintendent to own projects including scheduling, crew, and the client relationship.

**What you need**

* 5+ years managing or superintending electrical construction, with direct experience on **multi-family and commercial solar and EV charging installations**
* Working command of NEC plus Title 24 and CALGreen EV-ready requirements
* Proven track record running budgets and schedules on projects in the $100K–$2M+ range
* Experience with California utility interconnection and AHJ permitting

Under general supervision, operates as part of the care team performing a variety of functions such as greeting patients, patient registration, insurance coverage and eligibility verification, scheduling and telephone management. jobs.title: Contact Center Administrative Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Administrative Manager provides operational leadership and day-to-day management for the UCSF Health Contact Center, Referral and Access Centers, and Call Center. Reporting to the Administrative Director, this role is responsible for ensuring efficient, high-quality service delivery, staff performance, and continuous improvement across assigned service lines and pods. The Administrative Manager directly supervises Administrative Supervisors and supports the strategic goals set by senior leadership while maintaining operational stability and excellence in patient and provider access services.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Provide direct leadership and supervision to Administrative Supervisors, including conducting 1:1 meetings, performance evaluations, coaching, and professional development.
* Oversee daily operations by rotating attendance in pod & Home Team Huddles/Meetings, providing intra-day oversight of inbound call queues and referral workqueues, monitoring operational trends, and resolving escalated issues from Supervisors (emails, chats, calls, etc.).
* Manage daily communications by checking and responding to messages (email, electronic medical record In-Box, instant messages, and Home Team Leadership inquiries), while covering Supervisor absences as needed.
* Lead weekly activities, including preparation and facilitation of Cross-Functional Huddles, Leadership Meetings, Director/Manager Meetings, weekly performance scorecard reviews, and development of action plans for metrics in negative variance.
* Review and respond to escalated trends, recurring issues, and errors from Supervisors, collaborating on solutions and escalating to the Administrative Director with action plans when necessary.
* Approve bi-weekly timesheets and manage time-off requests for direct reports and their teams.
* Attend and actively contribute to various team meetings (Director/Manager Meetings,UCSF and FPO Manager’s Meetings, and PDSAs), while leading Steering Committees and PDSA sub-team activities and presenting topics as required)
* Drive continuous improvement by submitting tickets, completing Leader Standard Work, reviewing Standard Work updates, and supporting training and quality improvement initiatives.
* Oversee staffing, onboarding, recruitment, and training activities, including precepting new Supervisors, creating daily staffing plans, and supporting go-live and pod stabilization efforts.
* Participate in ad-hoc activities such as special projects, performance management, new hire orientation and technology troubleshooting.
* Champion the Medical Center’s House and Telephone Standards and promote a culture of accountability, recognition, and exceptional customer service.
* Serve as a key liaison between Supervisors, frontline teams, service lines, and senior leadership to ensure alignment and timely resolution of operational issues.

**Department Overview**

The UCSF Contact Center is an integrated team that supports both patient and provider requests for access to care at UCSF Health. Administrative functions include 1) appointment scheduling, 2) referral intake, review and processing,3) coordinating any other administrative or clinical patient call-based requests to support effective care delivery.

The UCSF Faculty Practice Organization (FPO) is made of up of more than 2,500 clinicians across multiple campuses and satellite clinics. The UCSF Patient Care Access team supports the organization’s goal to be the #1 Health System in Northern California in health care value, patient experience, and employee engagement by ensuring our ambulatory clinics provide timely access to care for our patients. We strive to provide care when, where and how our patients need it. The team works closely with practices to support improvement efforts and with various departments across the organization (e.g., marketing, IT) to set strategic goals and develop innovative patient care.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent combination of experience / training.
* Five (5) years of supervisory experience in an Ambulatory Care/Access Center setting
* In depth clinic / center patient care management skills. Practice management knowledge in scheduling, customer-service methods, regulatory compliance, accreditation requirements, and / or information technology. Familiar with the policies, best practices, and standards involved with effective clinic / center administration. In-depth knowledge of patient population served and the requirements for the delivery of services.
* Proven ability to organize, manage multiple priorities, and delegate work functions efficiently.
* Demonstrated managerial skills and human resources management knowledge, including staff deployment, resource utilization, budgeting and financial management, quality improvement, and program planning and implementation.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communications skills to convey complex information, instructions, and guidelines in a clear, concise, and specific manner, and to influence and persuade all levels of staff.
* Knowledge of relevant healthcare and clinic operations information technology, including billing systems and patient care workflows and processes.
* Demonstrated knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, as well as related legislative, accreditation, licensing, and compliance environments.
* Ability to work independently and in a team environment
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree in nursing, health or the health care administration field
* Experience with ambulatory care clinical practices and/or Centralized Call/Referral Services
* Experience using EMR-EPIC/APeX.

As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

The Infrastructure Supply Chain and Manufacturing Operations Group (ISM) aims to establish Google as the undisputed leader in AI/ML infrastructure by building the highest performance, most cost-effective, and most reliable AI/ML infrastructure on the planet. The team has end to end accountability for ingesting demand signals from the product area and then outputting TPU, GPU, Compute, Storage and machines. We are responsible for supplier technology evaluation and selection, strategic investments, sourcing negotiations and commercial agreements, supply operations and assurance, silicon quality assurance and Global Manufacturing operations.  
  
As a Supply Chain Program Manager, you will drive the operational excellence and strategic planning for material flow supporting Google’s critical technical infrastructure supply chain. You will be instrumental in ensuring the right materials are in the right place at the right time to meet complex, global production demands. This role requires a blend of supply and demand tracking, deep analytical excellence, and process optimization through dashboard automation.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Track supply delivery schedules, identifying and mitigating supply risks (e.g., component shortages, lead time changes).
* Create supply/demand models with what-if scenario analysis capabilities for our technical infrastructure server and intra-DC networking component deliveries.
* Drive key processes to align material supply with demand forecasts at a component level.
* Design, build, and maintain automated data pipelines and interactive dashboards (e.g., in dashboards or similar BI tools) to provide real-time, actionable insights into material availability, consumption rates, and risk exposure.
* Utilize advanced analytics (SQL, Python) to model supply scenarios, analyze cost-to-serve, and identify opportunities for optimization.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
### **What is Verse?**

The race to AI has become the race to power. Every breakthrough in artificial intelligence depends on one thing: access to electricity. But across the country, aging grid infrastructure and years-long interconnection queues are slowing the deployment of the data centers that will power the next generation of innovation. Solving this challenge isn't just about energy it's about unlocking the future of AI.

At Verse, we're building the energy intelligence platform for the AI economy. Our software helps the world's largest energy consumers achieve faster, cheaper, and cleaner power by combining real-time control of energy assets with complete visibility into their energy portfolio. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, GV, Coatue, and NVIDIA, and built by pioneers in grid-scale batteries, energy markets, and enterprise software, we're redefining how the world's most ambitious organizations access and manage energy.

### **The Role**

We're hiring a **Customer Success Manager** to own the relationship and commercial outcomes for a portfolio of enterprise energy buyers after they sign. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role for someone who knows renewable energy procurement inside and out and can be a trusted advisor to sophisticated energy and sustainability teams from day one.

You'll join a lean, fast-moving Customer Success function and help shape how it operates as we scale. A key part of this role is growing with Verse into **dispatch intelligence and battery storage optimization** real-time products that will define the next chapter of the platform. You'll be the person who makes sure our customers adopt the platform, realize value, renew, and grow.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Own the relationship, adoption, and commercial outcomes** for a book of enterprise accounts from signature onward.
* **Drive** **revenue** **retention**lead renewals, protect gross retention, and identify and close in-footprint expansion.
* **Serve as a trusted energy advisor****,** guiding customers on PPA/VPPA portfolio management, invoice and settlement validation, generation forecasting, availability and production guarantees, and REC/EAC management.
* **Run executive business reviews**, build account health scoring, and manage senior stakeholder relationships up the org chart.
* **Translate the platform's analytical outputs**into clear business value and confident reporting for your customers.
* **Partner cross-****functionally**with Sales on closed-won transitions and expansion, with Delivery on onboarding and implementation quality, and with Product to channel voice-of-customer into the roadmap.
* **Be a driving force in Verse's move into real-time dispatch intelligence and battery storage optimization** a central part of this role as those products scale.
* **Own your metrics**revenue retention, renewal rate, customer health, and referenceable customers.

### **What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* **4+ years**in customer success, account management, or client-facing advisory/consulting — ideally in energy, cleantech, or enterprise SaaS.
* **Deep, working knowledge of renewable energy procurement:**PPAs/VPPAs, RECs/EACs, and wholesale power markets (e.g., ERCOT, PJM, MISO, SPP).
* **A track record**managing large enterprise relationships and owning retention and expansion outcomes.
* **Comfort with data and analytics** able to interrogate technical outputs and turn them into a business narrative.
* **Outstanding executive communication****,** and the instinct to ask the probing questions that surface what a customer actually needs.
* **A builder's mindset**comfortable operating with ambiguity in a startup, and willing to travel to customers (~20–30%).
* **Bonus:**exposure to real-time energy markets, dispatch optimization, battery storage, or energy trading; a background in energy advisory or asset management; or experience helping stand up a customer success function.

### **What Makes Verse a Great Place to Work?**

* Lead with Empathy: We lift each other up with humility and kindness, always putting colleagues and customers first
* Be Honest & Transparent: We prioritize effective communication to build trust with our team, customers, and stakeholders
* Move with Balance & Precision: We believe speed and perseverance must be accompanied by thoughtfulness and reflection
* Leave the World a Better Place: We are passionate about our mission, and we strive to create a sustainable world for future generations

### **Base Pay Range**

**$115,000 - $150,000**

This is the estimated base salary range for this position, which does not include the value of benefits or a potential equity grant. A wide range of factors are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to level, skill sets, market conditions, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and business and organizational needs.

### **Benefits and Employee Perks**

* Competitive compensation and equity grant at a high-growth start up
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and vision insurance, and 401k
* Flexible hours, fully remote position, and unlimited PTO
* Diverse and inclusive working environment

The Patient Care Manager is a Registered Nurse who provides unit leadership and works in partnership with nursing, the healthcare team, hospital/system leaders to develop a quality practice setting that support professional nursing and quality patient care. The Patient Care Manager is accountable for the effective delivery of competent, compassionate, and efficient patient care. Responsibilities include coordination of patient care; supervision of a professional team that includes multiple nursing and other staff as appropriate; administrative and budget management; troubleshooting of problem areas; organizational change management; ensuring compliance with accreditation and regulatory standards; quality assurance/quality improvement; safety and risk management requirements as well as actualization of hospital and unit policies, goals and objectives. Stanford Health Care

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
**Office Manager, San Francisco**

Thomvest is looking for a Part time Office Manager to run our office in San Francisco's South Park neighborhood. This is the person who keeps everything humming, from the first coffee of the morning to the last guest out the door. For many founders, investors, and visitors, you'll also be the first face of Thomvest they meet.

**What You'll Do**

* **Office management.** Keep the office running smoothly day to day. You'll arrange repairs and maintenance, serve as the main contact with building management, keep the office and kitchen stocked and organized, and handle mail and packages.
* **Vendor and contract management.** Choose and manage the vendors who keep us going, including repairs, office equipment, security, cleaning, and catering. You'll keep an eye on contract renewals and costs, and manage the subscriptions and licenses for the tools the team relies on.
* **Investor and portfolio meetings.** Make our in-office board meetings, LP meetings, and portfolio company meetings run well. You'll handle scheduling, catering, AV, materials, and follow-up.
* **Team events.** Plan and host team events, offsites, and networking evenings, including our annual "ThomFest" holiday party. You'll also help with founder and portfolio events that grow Thomvest's presence in the Bay Area.
* **People operations.** Give every new employee, intern, and visitor a great start, with equipment, accounts, and building access ready on day one.
* **IT and systems.** Be the go-to person for office technology, including Wi-Fi, conference room AV, printers, and laptops. You'll coordinate with outside IT support when needed.

Our team is often traveling or in meetings, so you'll be the steady presence that holds the office together. Helping keep our culture both fun and mission-driven is a big part of the job.

The core of the role is clearly defined, but it doesn't stop there. It will grow with the firm's needs and with your own interests. You'll pitch in wherever help is needed, own special projects from start to finish, and find ways to make how we work a little better every day. With a small team of 2 to 4 people on site, you'll get a real view of venture capital up close and plenty of room to grow.

**Qualifications**

* Prior experience as an Office Manager. A startup background is strongly preferred.
* Comfortable working in both Microsoft Office, Google Workspace and Claude.

**Who You Are**

* **A hardworking self-starter.** You spot what needs doing and get it done without waiting to be asked.
* **An owner.** You treat the office as your own, see projects through to the end, and sweat the details.
* **Creative.** You're always looking for a better way, whether it's how the office runs or how we host our next event.
* **Friendly and outgoing.** You love meeting new people and enjoy being the one who makes founders, investors, and guests feel at home.
* **Passionate about startups.** The companies and founders we work with genuinely excite you.

**Compensation and Benefits**

We offer a competitive salary and we're also a fun, close-knit group. We help each other grow, both professionally and as friends, and we make time to get to know each other at company events.

**Location**

Four days a week in office. South Park, San Francisco, CA. And yes, we're a dog-friendly office!

**About Thomvest**

Thomvest is a multi-stage venture capital firm with ~$1 billion under management. We invest in and work with companies in fintech, cybersecurity, and AI infrastrutucture. Since 1996, we've made 100+ investments, and 70% of our companies have gone public, been acquired, or continue to grow as independent businesses. To learn more, visit our website www.thomvest.com

Job Type: Part-time

Pay: $50,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

jobs.description:
Position for Program Coordinator- St Jude Sub-Saharan African Regional Hub
  
This role if On-site in Johannesburg - South Africa, we are open to people that are willing to relocate, and also, we offer relocation allowance.
  
St. Jude Children's Research is a world-renowned institution dedicated to advancing cures and improving outcomes for children with cancer and other catastrophic diseases through exceptional research, clinical care, and education. The Department of Global Pediatric Medicine (GPM) at St. Jude Global (SJG) partners with governments, healthcare institutions, and international organizations to strengthen health systems, build clinical capacity, and expand equitable access to high-quality care worldwide. Sub-Saharan Africa bears a disproportionate burden of childhood cancer, with many children facing delayed diagnosis, limited access to specialised treatment, treatment abandonment, and significantly lower survival rates than those achieved in high-income countries. The World Health Organisation's Global Initiative for Childhood Cancer (GICC) aims to increase survival for children with cancer to at least 60% globally by 2030, through strengthened health systems and equitable access to quality care. As a principal partner in implementing the GICC, St. Jude Global collaborates with countries throughout Sub-Saharan Africa to enhance national childhood cancer programs, develop the pediatric oncology workforce, improve the quality of care, broaden access to essential medicines and diagnostics, and generate evidence to facilitate sustainable improvements in outcomes. St. Jude Global is expanding its Regional Programs to enhance collaboration and expedite impact across priority regions. The Regional Hub Program Coordinator will support the Sub-Saharan Africa Regional Hub by working in close partnership with the Regional Hub Program Manager and both regional and global stakeholders to coordinate programs, partnerships, and operational activities throughout the region. Situated within the Sub-Saharan Africa Regional Hub, the Program Coordinator will be responsible for comprehensive daily programmatic and operational support, thereby assisting in the effective planning, implementation, monitoring, and alignment of regional initiatives with the mission and strategic priorities of St. Jude. This role presents an opportunity to contribute to the establishment of new systems, processes, and partnerships aimed at enhancing outcomes for children with cancer and other catastrophic diseases across Sub-Saharan Africa.

jobs.title: Case Manager / Patient Support - Non-Clinical (11-8p EST)
jobs.description:
**Momentum Life Sciences helps the healthcare industry connect, motivate, and empower people to engage in their health.**

By combining the power of real, personal connections and the convenience of technology, Momentum delivers solutions that drive better health and business outcomes.

**Who We Are:** Momentum is a leading provider of patient and healthcare professional engagement solutions with more than 30 years of experience in the healthcare industry.

**What We Do:** We partner with life science companies to design, build and deliver effective and efficient patient support programs helping patients achieve a better start and longer stay on therapy.

**How We Do It:** Our patient engagement and Clinical Nurse Educator platform delivers personalized, evidence-based human and digital interventions.

**About the Position**

The Non-Clinical Case Manager provides personalized support to patients and caregivers through inbound and outbound interactions across assigned patient support programs. This role builds trusting relationships, uses open-ended questions and active listening to understand patient needs, and applies motivational interviewing techniques to explore goals and barriers to engagement.

Responsibilities include communicating approved program information, connecting patients with resources, coordinating follow-up, and helping patients navigate concerns and identify appropriate next steps. Working collaboratively with program partners and internal teams, the Case Manager applies critical thinking, maintains accurate documentation, and follows established guidelines to deliver a consistent, compassionate patient experience.

**Essential Functions**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* Provide personalized inbound and outbound patient and caregiver support through approved communication channels, including telephone, email, chat, and text, according to program requirements and established timelines.

* Build rapport and establish trusting relationships through empathy, active listening, emotional intelligence, and patient-centered communication.

* Utilize open-ended questions, reflective listening, and motivational interviewing techniques to understand patient concerns, explore goals, identify barriers, and encourage meaningful engagement.

* Communicate approved program information, available services, and resources clearly, adapting conversations to individual patient needs while confirming understanding.

* Apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills to clarify concerns, identify unresolved needs, evaluate available resources, and determine appropriate next steps within established program guidelines.

* Collaborate with patients and caregivers to identify realistic next steps, coordinate appropriate resources, and follow through on agreed-upon actions.
