jobs.title: Property Management Operations Manager - Scattered-Site Residential
jobs.description:
Run day-to-day operations for a 300-door third-party residential property management company in Chicagoland. You'll lead a six-person leasing, maintenance, and admin team so the owner can focus on growth. At some larger companies, this seat is called Director of Property Management.

**About Domain Property Management**

Domain Property Management is a third-party residential property manager based in Logan Square on the North Side of Chicago, Illinois. We manage nearly 300 scattered-site rental units across Chicagoland — single-family homes, condos, and small multifamily buildings — on behalf of individual owners and investors. We will continue to grow the company intentionally with the right clients and the right properties.

Our team of six works remotely across the US and abroad: leasing, maintenance coordination, and administration. We run on Aptly, AppFolio, RentEngine, and Property Meld.

**The role**

Your job is to own property management operations so the owner doesn't have to. The team handles the daily execution — showings, work orders, rent collection, move-ins and move-outs. You make sure it happens well, on time, and without the owner stepping in.

Three things stay on your desk personally:

* **Owner relations.** You are the point of contact for our clients — the property owners. You answer their questions, review their statements, and keep them confident their property is in good hands.
* **Escalations.** When a tenant issue, a vendor dispute, or a maintenance problem gets past the team, it comes to you. You resolve it.
* **Maintenance billing.** You review and approve in-house maintenance charges to owners so the numbers are right before they go out.

Everything else is leadership: setting priorities, holding the team to standards, fixing broken processes, and reporting to the owner on how the portfolio is performing. You report directly to the owner and have authority over day-to-day decisions, hiring recommendations, and team performance.

**What you'll do**

* **Lead the team.** Manage six US-based and international teammates across leasing, maintenance coordination, and admin. Set weekly priorities, run check-ins, coach, and hold people accountable to clear standards.
* **Own owner relationships.** Serve as the primary contact for property owners. Handle onboarding, questions, statement reviews, and renewals of our management agreements.
* **Handle escalations.** Take tenant, vendor, and owner issues that the team can't resolve and close them out calmly and fairly.
* **Oversee leasing.** Make sure vacancies are marketed quickly, showings happen, applications are screened consistently, and renewals go out on time. Watch days-on-market and occupancy.
* **Oversee maintenance.** With the maintenance coordinator, make sure work orders are triaged, dispatched, and closed promptly. Review and approve maintenance billing to owners and tenants.
* **Oversee turnovers.** Keep move-outs, make-readies, and move-ins moving so units are rent-ready fast.
* **Watch the money.** Monitor rent collection, delinquencies, owner distributions, and AP/AR with the admin team. Flag problems before they become owner calls.
* **Fix the process.** Keep HubSpot workflows, AppFolio, and Property Meld clean and used the way they're meant to be. When something breaks repeatedly, redesign it.
* **Report up.** Give the owner a weekly operations summary and a monthly portfolio review: occupancy, delinquency, maintenance spend, owner churn.

**What you bring**

**Required**

* 3+ years at a third-party (fee-based) residential property management company managing single-family, condo, or scattered-site rentals. On-site multifamily, HOA/community association, or owner-operator experience alone is not a fit for this role.
* 1+ years leading or supervising others — a team, a pod, or an assistant and coordinators.
* Working knowledge of residential maintenance: you can read a vendor estimate, tell a reasonable repair from a padded one, and explain a charge to an owner.
* Comfortable managing a remote team, including teammates in other time zones.
* Hands-on with property management software (AppFolio, Buildium, Propertyware, or similar) and a CRM. HubSpot and Property Meld experience is a plus.
* Clear, professional written and spoken English — you'll be the voice to owners.
* Calm under pressure and decisive. Escalations end with you.
* Based in the US and able to work Central Time business hours.

**Not required, but helpful**

* Experience in the Chicago-area rental market or Illinois landlord-tenant rules (RLTO, CRLTO, security deposit law).
* Illinois real estate broker or managing broker license
* Experience at a company that grew from under 200 doors to 500+.

**How to apply**

All communication will be through indeed. Please submit your application. If your application meets our initial renew, you will be contacted for a follow up.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $65,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Retirement plan

Application Question(s):

* Are you based in the U.S. and willing to work Central Time business hours?
* 1. Have you worked for a third-party (fee-based) property management company that manages properties owned by other people?

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
Case Manager – Social Security Disability Claims

Oct 26, 2026 · @Karl

**Disability Specialists · Cook, MN or remote · $50,000–$60,000 a year**

Why this job matters

Most people who apply for Social Security disability are already going through one of the hardest stretches of their lives. They're out of work, managing a health condition, and facing a federal process with long waits, strict deadlines, and a lot of paperwork. Many are denied the first time and don't realize they can appeal.

That's where we come in. Disability Specialists represents people through SSDI and SSI claims, from the first application through appeal. As our Case Manager, you'll keep each client's claim moving: you'll know where it stands, what it still needs, and what comes next, and you'll make sure the client knows too.

The role

You'll manage a caseload of claims at different stages, working with clients, Social Security field and hearing offices, and medical providers. The job is part paperwork, part detective work, and part customer care. A good day ends with a complete file, a deadline met, and a client who feels less alone in the process.

Your work at each stage of a claim

Stage

What you'll do

**Intake**

Schedule intake appointments and send reminder letters. Handle intakes for new and returning clients when needed, and make first contact with each new client by phone or letter.

**Representation and billing**

Receive and process representation paperwork. Enter charges from the first client conference and from hearings in Prevail, our case management software.

**Working the claim with SSA**

Process paperwork from Social Security and run regular status checks. Keep each client's medical, address, and phone information current, and submit updates when needed. Check claims for quality and accuracy before they go out.

**Denials and appeals**

Process denials at every level, including decisions from Administrative Law Judges and the Appeals Council. Write "good cause" requests when a deadline was missed for a valid reason.

**Hearing level**

Complete pre-hearing forms and review exhibit files. Submit on-the-record requests, dire need requests, and stipulations.

**Appeals Council and federal court**

File Appeals Council appeals and track their status. Set up client calls and appointments when a case moves to the Appeals Council or federal court. When an Appeals Council case ends, close the file and start a new claim if the client needs one.

**Closing files**

Close finished files and withdraw applications or hearing requests when needed. Handle the files of clients who have passed away with care.

**Every day**

* Answer incoming calls from Social Security, hearing offices, and the Appeals Council
* Sort mail, email, and faxes from clients and hearing offices, and route each one to the right person
* Work closely with our representatives and support staff
* Help with other tasks as needed

Who thrives in this role

* **You're organized by nature.** You can keep many open files straight, and you notice when something is missing.
* **You write and speak clearly.** You can explain a confusing letter from Social Security to a worried client, then fill out a precise form for a government reviewer.
* **You stay patient and kind under pressure.** Clients may be in pain, frustrated, or scared. You stay steady and respectful.
* **You follow through.** A records request isn't done when it's sent. It's done when the records arrive.
* **You manage your own time well.** You can plan your day and set priorities without someone checking in, which matters even more if you work remotely.
* **You're comfortable with technology.** You use standard office software easily and can learn a case management system quickly.

**Helpful, but not required:**

* Experience with Prevail case management software
* Knowledge of SSDI and SSI rules and procedures
* A background in social services, healthcare, legal support, insurance claims, or customer service

New to disability claims? If the rest of this sounds like you, we'd still like to hear from you.

Pay and benefits

* **Salary:** $48,000–$60,000, based on experience
* **2 weeks paid vacation** starting your first year
* **24 hours of additional PTO**
* **IRA with [3]% employer match**
* **Health care stipend**
* **Flexibility:** Work from our Cook, MN office or remotely, for qualified candidates
* **Work with a clear purpose:** every finished file moves someone closer to the support they need

Pay: $48,000.00 - $60,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Life insurance
* Paid training
* Parental leave

Work Location: Remote

We are seeking a sharp, versatile operator to work alongside our Vice President of Operations and, over time, take over the day-to-day running of one of the most financially consequential programs in our business. It is high-volume, governed by regulation, and run against hard deadlines. Missing one can mean losing revenue permanently. No two days look alike. One day you may be building an executive roll-up from messy data; the next, untangling a payer dispute or standing up a new workflow.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Lumenci is hiring a remote Customer Success Manager to deliver product demos and onboard new customers for iLumos, our AI-powered patent intelligence platform. In this fast-paced, customer-facing role, you will run live demos and discovery, handle objections, and help Sales close deals with law firms, corporate IP teams, and patent investors.

**About Lumenci**
=================

Founded in 2018, Lumenci is a full-lifecycle intellectual property platform specializing in patent litigation, expert witness testimony, and patent monetization for leading corporations and global law firms across the software, telecommunications, semiconductor, and emerging technology sectors.

A key part of our model is the integration of deep technical expertise with litigation strategy. Our teams support high-stakes disputes by developing technical narratives, performing rigorous analysis, including reverse engineering and source-code review, and partnering with world-class expert witnesses whose testimony shapes case outcomes in courts and arbitration forums worldwide. Alongside our services business, our iLumos platform delivers expert-guided AI for patent intelligence, moving clients from portfolio analysis to action in minutes rather than months.

Today we work with more than 200 clients worldwide. We have analyzed over 100,000 patents, tested more than 1,200 products, and supported clients in raising over $200M in IP financing, with more than $3.5B tied to verdicts, settlements, and cost savings. That work is delivered by 150 consultants and more than 100 technical experts with exceptional academic backgrounds.

Three Lumenci leaders are named in the IAM Strategy 300: The World's Leading IP Strategists 2026, and Lumenci ranks #14 in Vault's 2026 Top Consulting Asia-Pacific rankings. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we deliver end-to-end support spanning technical analysis, expert strategy, valuation, and monetization execution. We are backed by VSS Capital Partners and Century Equity Partners, and we are growing quickly.

**Employment Type:** Full-time, exempt  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote  
**Location:** US  
**Reports To:** iLumos GTM Leader  
**Travel:** 10–15% (customer meetings, internal sessions, and industry events)

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

iLumos is generating strong inbound interest from law firms, corporate IP teams, and patent investors, and we need someone who can turn that interest into customers. We are looking for an experienced demo professional who can join conversations quickly, show the product's value clearly, and help Sales close deals.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for a professional with 3–5 years of experience who has delivered more than 100 product demos and brings energy, confidence, and presence to every conversation. You will own live demos, discovery, and new customer onboarding, then transition customers to our account team for long-term relationship management.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Product demos and discovery**

* Deliver live, tailored iLumos demos to prospective customers, often on short notice as new leads come in
* Run discovery to understand each prospect's workflows, priorities, and decision criteria
* Show how iLumos solves real patent and IP challenges in terms customers care about
* Adapt each demo to the audience, from patent attorneys and IP counsel to investors and executives

**Objection handling and deal support**

* Answer product, workflow, and value questions confidently during live conversations
* Handle objections and move conversations toward clear next steps
* Partner with Sales to advance opportunities and help close deals
* Support pilot programs by demoing and onboarding pilot users, while Sales owns the pilot
* Share prospect feedback and common objections with the GTM Leader and Product

**Customer onboarding**

* Lead onboarding for new customers so they start using iLumos quickly and confidently
* Walk customers through setup, core workflows, and best practices
* Transition customers smoothly to the account team once onboarding is complete, with a clear handoff of goals, stakeholders, and next steps

**Demo materials**

* Build and refine demo scripts, talk tracks, and objection-handling guides
* Help teammates deliver iLumos demos more consistently

**What You Bring**
------------------

**Required**

* 3–5 years of experience in a customer-facing software role, such as customer success, customer onboarding, pre-sales, solutions consulting, or product specialist
* Has delivered 100+ live product demos to business or professional buyers
* Experience at a patent, IP technology, or legal technology company
* Proven ability to run discovery, handle objections, and move prospects to next steps
* Experience onboarding new customers onto a software product
* Strong presence, energy, and communication skills in live conversations
* Availability to support demos on short notice during business hours
* Ability to travel 10–15% for customer meetings, internal sessions, and industry events

**Preferred**

* Experience demoing AI, analytics, or data-driven products
* Familiarity with patent and IP workflows, such as prior art search, patent landscaping, portfolio analysis, or litigation support
* Technical, engineering, or legal background, such as a patent agent, engineering degree, or JD
* Experience with Salesforce or HubSpot

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

**First 30 days:** Learn the iLumos product, customers, and core patent and IP workflows. Shadow demos and begin delivering them with support.

**First 60 days:** Deliver demos on your own and cover incoming demo requests promptly. Lead onboarding for new customers.

**First 90 days:** Consistently move demos to clear next steps with Sales. Onboard new customers and hand them off smoothly to Sales Enablement. Deliver a reusable demo script and objection-handling guide.

**Why You Will Love Working for Lumenci**

**About LawnStarter**

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $750M in bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for home services: three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, Home Gnome), one shared platform.

**About Product at LawnStarter**

Our BHAG: 1+ job per household, every year. Getting there means winning on four fronts at once: more customers, more Pros, excellent service for both sides, and an AI-run company that moves faster than its size should allow.

**About the First Service Experience at LawnStarter**

Every new customer meets us the same way. They land on our home page or marketing site, then move through a signup and booking flow where they get a quote, pick a service and a schedule, and pay. That flow runs across all three brands and brings in most of the company's new customers.

We built it many years ago. It's too long, and we lose customers at too many steps. So the real question isn't how to remove a step. It's whether the experience designed still makes sense at all, or whether it should be rethought entirely as an AI-native, agentic experience.

**The Role**

You'll own the consumer's first service experience: everything from the moment someone first encounters LawnStarter through signing up and booking their first service. You'll decide what that experience should become, then build it with engineering, design, operations, marketing, and data.

This is not a funnel-optimization job. We want someone who looks at a five-year-old flow, asks what a homeowner would want if we started from nothing today, and then ships the answer.

As Lead PM, you're an individual contributor with Lead-level scope and no direct reports. You'll work closely with the Consumer Experience lead, the Pro Experience PM, the Pricing PM, and the Conversational AI & Agents lead. You'll report to the Sr. Director of Product.

**What makes this role different:**

* **A rebuild, not a tune-up.** You're rethinking the experience from first principles, not polishing the one we have.
* **AI-native from the first screen.** You'll decide whether a form is even the right way to sign up anymore.
* **Every new customer passes through your work.** Across three brands, this is how people meet LawnStarter.

**What You'll Own**

* **The vision:** What the first service experience should become, and the plan to get there.
* **The home page and marketing site:** The first impression, and the first decision a customer makes about us.
* **Signup and booking for all three brands:** LawnStarter, Lawn Love, and Home Gnome.
* **Funnel data:** The numbers that show where customers move forward and where they leave.
* **Quotes, services, and scheduling:** How a customer gets a price, picks a service, and chooses when it happens.
* **Payment:** Checkout, including Apple Pay and Google Pay.

**Problems to Solve**

**Deciding whether today's experience should exist at all.**  
You'll start from what a homeowner needs to book their first service and work backward. Every step we have today has to earn its place again, and you'll defend each call with evidence.

**Designing an AI-native, agentic way to sign up.**  
Someone who wants their lawn mowed shouldn't have to learn our product to book it. What can an agent handle for them, and where does a person still want control? You'll answer with prototypes in front of real customers, not opinions in a meeting.

**Rebuilding without breaking what works.**  
This flow brings in most of our new customers. You'll need a path that proves the new experience works with real customers before it replaces the old one. Bold and careful at once: that's the job.

**Moving levers you don't own.**  
Signup touches pricing, Pro supply, and operations. Change how customers book and you change what Pros see and how jobs get priced. You'll work through the people who own those levers and bring them along on a vision that changes their world too.

**What Success Looks Like (Year 1)**

* A vision leadership rallies behind: A clear picture of the reimagined first service experience, grounded in what customers need.
* A first piece of it, live: A meaningful part of that experience shipped to real customers. Not a deck.
* Signup conversion goes up: More of the people who find us become customers.
* More customers sign up for their first service: The reimagined experience gets more households to that first booking.
* First service CSAT is high: Customers rate their first service experience highly (customer satisfaction, CSAT).

  
**Requirements**

**Who You Are:**

**Experience:** Customer obsessed with 6+ years in consumer product management, focused on consumer experience.

**A visionary who ships.** You look at an experience everyone has accepted and ask why it exists. Then you build the replacement. Is your instinct to improve what's there, one step at a time? Then this isn't your role.

**Customer-obsessed, for the long run.** You care whether a customer converts and whether they're glad they did. Short-term signups never win over the customer's experience in your book. Someone who'd juice conversion at the customer's expense won't last here.

**An AI builder.** You've shipped AI-powered or agentic consumer experiences. You prototype new signup experiences with LLMs and agents, read customer transcripts to hear where people get stuck, and use AI to pull apart funnel data in an afternoon. If you've only watched AI from the sidelines, this role is unlikely to be a good fit.

**Your own analyst.** You run your own funnel analysis and product analytics, and you know which step loses people before anyone builds you a dashboard. If you need someone else to pull your numbers, this is unlikely to be a good fit.

**CI Azumano** is Seneca Holdings' full-service travel management company for businesses, governments, and personal travelers. We offer 24/7 support for travelers while also supporting customers with travel expense management, policy implementation, technology solutions, business intelligence tools, and vendor negotiations.

Our team of talented individuals is what makes us successful. To support our team, we provide a balanced mix of benefits and programs. Your total rewards package includes competitive pay, benefits, and perks, flexible work-life balance, professional development opportunities, and performance and recognition programs. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability, voluntary benefit programs (critical illness, hospital, and accident), health savings and flexible spending accounts, and retirement 401K plan. One of our fundamental principles is to offer competitive health and welfare benefits to our team members, providing coverage and care for you and your family. Full-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefits and paid leave programs. We pride ourselves on our collaborative work environment and culture, which embraces our mission of providing financial and non-financial benefits back to the members of the Seneca Nation.

* Know your client better than your client contact.
* Create a "win-win" team approach to solve client issues.
* Understands the financial side of travel management and works in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to drive profitability by accessing and meeting a client's needs.
* Interprets contracts and provides guidance to internal stakeholders to meet client SLA's while staying in scope of deliverables.

* Create annual business plans with customers that are measurable and tracks progress to goals.

* Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of financial travel program drivers.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and reporting tools.

jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Patient Access Specialist (PAS) completes core Patient Access functions from initial intake through completion of assigned patient accounts, including fax triage, entry of patient and insurance information, eligibility and benefit verification, prior authorization initiation and follow-up, resolution of missing information, and accurate account documentation. The PAS maintains ownership of assigned accounts and ensures required activities are completed accurately and within established turnaround times. This role collaborates closely with Patient Access, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), Clinical Services, patients, referring offices, health plans, and other stakeholders.

  

**What you’ll be doing…**

**Role Responsibilities**

* Retrieve, review, and triage incoming faxes and other correspondence as part of the initial intake process; identify request type, urgency, required action, and missing information.

* Prioritize STAT, urgent, and time-sensitive requests according to established procedures and assume ownership of assigned accounts through completion.
* Verify patient eligibility and insurance coverage using Waystar, payer portals, direct payer communication, and other authorized resources.

* Review accounts for missing documentation or information and proactively work toward resolution while maintaining complete and accurate account statuses and notes.

* Maintain compliance with HIPAA, applicable regulations, payer requirements, and CND policies.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

* Proficiency with Salesforce, Waystar, payer portals, and laboratory billing platforms.
* Working knowledge of commercial and government insurance coverage.

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
Case Manager – Social Security Disability Claims

Oct 26, 2026 · @Karl

**Disability Specialists · Cook, MN or remote · $50,000–$60,000 a year**

Why this job matters

Most people who apply for Social Security disability are already going through one of the hardest stretches of their lives. They're out of work, managing a health condition, and facing a federal process with long waits, strict deadlines, and a lot of paperwork. Many are denied the first time and don't realize they can appeal.

That's where we come in. Disability Specialists represents people through SSDI and SSI claims, from the first application through appeal. As our Case Manager, you'll keep each client's claim moving: you'll know where it stands, what it still needs, and what comes next, and you'll make sure the client knows too.

The role

You'll manage a caseload of claims at different stages, working with clients, Social Security field and hearing offices, and medical providers. The job is part paperwork, part detective work, and part customer care. A good day ends with a complete file, a deadline met, and a client who feels less alone in the process.

Your work at each stage of a claim

Stage

What you'll do

**Intake**

Schedule intake appointments and send reminder letters. Handle intakes for new and returning clients when needed, and make first contact with each new client by phone or letter.

**Representation and billing**

Receive and process representation paperwork. Enter charges from the first client conference and from hearings in Prevail, our case management software.

**Working the claim with SSA**

Process paperwork from Social Security and run regular status checks. Keep each client's medical, address, and phone information current, and submit updates when needed. Check claims for quality and accuracy before they go out.

**Denials and appeals**

Process denials at every level, including decisions from Administrative Law Judges and the Appeals Council. Write "good cause" requests when a deadline was missed for a valid reason.

**Hearing level**

Complete pre-hearing forms and review exhibit files. Submit on-the-record requests, dire need requests, and stipulations.

**Appeals Council and federal court**

File Appeals Council appeals and track their status. Set up client calls and appointments when a case moves to the Appeals Council or federal court. When an Appeals Council case ends, close the file and start a new claim if the client needs one.

**Closing files**

Close finished files and withdraw applications or hearing requests when needed. Handle the files of clients who have passed away with care.

**Every day**

* Answer incoming calls from Social Security, hearing offices, and the Appeals Council
* Sort mail, email, and faxes from clients and hearing offices, and route each one to the right person
* Work closely with our representatives and support staff
* Help with other tasks as needed

Who thrives in this role

* **You're organized by nature.** You can keep many open files straight, and you notice when something is missing.
* **You write and speak clearly.** You can explain a confusing letter from Social Security to a worried client, then fill out a precise form for a government reviewer.
* **You stay patient and kind under pressure.** Clients may be in pain, frustrated, or scared. You stay steady and respectful.
* **You follow through.** A records request isn't done when it's sent. It's done when the records arrive.
* **You manage your own time well.** You can plan your day and set priorities without someone checking in, which matters even more if you work remotely.
* **You're comfortable with technology.** You use standard office software easily and can learn a case management system quickly.

**Helpful, but not required:**

* Experience with Prevail case management software
* Knowledge of SSDI and SSI rules and procedures
* A background in social services, healthcare, legal support, insurance claims, or customer service

New to disability claims? If the rest of this sounds like you, we'd still like to hear from you.

Pay and benefits

* **Salary:** $48,000–$60,000, based on experience
* **2 weeks paid vacation** starting your first year
* **24 hours of additional PTO**
* **IRA with [3]% employer match**

jobs.title: Clinical Product Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**Clinical Product Operations Specialist**
==========================================

**Hello Alpha** | Full-time | Remote | Reports to the Chief Medical Officer

**About Hello Alpha**
---------------------

Hello Alpha is a telemedicine company. Our team of engineers, clinicians and operators builds the web platform that patients, care teams and partner organizations use every day.  
  
**Alpha Values:**

* **We are mission-driven -** We’re changing the paradigm of healthcare for patients who are historically underrepresented due to sex, race, gender, language, economic status, location, disability, and other diverse backgrounds. We empower our Primary Care Providers with a foundation in women’s health to administer patient-centered care throughout a woman’s lifespan.
* **We put patients first -** We prioritize what’s best for our patients, not what’s easier or more profitable. We do whatever it takes to provide excellent care and empower patients to take control of their health.
* **One team, One Dream -** We work together as a team to bring to life our vision of a more just healthcare system. We trust each other, communicate openly and honestly. We give credit where it is due, provide opportunities for employee growth and development, assume good intentions, and celebrate our wins as a team.
* **Diversity is at our core -** Alpha exists to bring a more accessible, equitable system to care for the whole woman regardless of age, income, and location. We are inclusive, welcoming, and value different perspectives.
* **We are data-driven -** Alphanauts love data and value facts over opinions. We use evidence-based science to highlight the clinical value of our mission.
* **We are proactive and positive -** Alphanauts learn by doing and address challenges without waiting or worrying about their scope. We are pragmatic and value progress over perfection. We are optimistic and believe in the power of positivity.

**About the role**
------------------

We are hiring a Clinical Product Operations Specialist to be the connective tissue between product, engineering, our care team and our partners. You will own three things end to end: the content that powers our patient-facing experience in Contentful, the data requests that keep the business informed in Amazon QuickSight, and the bug triage process that keeps our platform reliable. You will also write the standard operating procedures (SOPs) that make our work repeatable, act as the product expert for our clinical team, and help shape how we plan, ship and communicate releases.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Manage content in Contentful**

* Create, review and publish content entries, and keep a calendar of scheduled changes.
* Run a QA pass in our staging environment before anything patient-facing goes live.
* Keep content structure, naming and permissions consistent, and archive what is outdated.
* Write clear requests to engineering when a content type needs to change, and verify the result.

**Own data requests and reporting in QuickSight**

* Run a single intake process for data requests so every ask has an owner, a purpose and a deadline.
* Build and maintain QuickSight dashboards, and turn recurring requests into self-serve reports.
* Write SQL for ad hoc analysis and define key metrics so numbers match across reports.
* Check reports against underlying data before they go to partners, finance or leadership.
* Handle patient data responsibly by pulling only what each request needs.

**Run bug tracking and triage**

* Collect bug reports from our care team, support and partners, and link duplicates.
* Reproduce issues in staging and write up clear recaps with steps, expected and actual behavior, and screenshots.
* Lead a weekly bug review, verify fixes before closing, and update the person who reported each issue.

**Be the product expert for our clinical team**

* Know the patient dashboard and the care-team dashboard well enough to answer "how does this work?" from clinicians and clinical operations.
* Be the first point of contact for clinician questions and workflow issues; resolve what you can and escalate the rest.
* Be the owner of EMR (e.g., Athena) and resolve integration issues with EMR tech support
* Translate clinical workflow needs into clear, well-scoped requests for product and engineering.
* Walk clinicians through new features and changes, and bring their feedback back to the product team.
* Keep clinician-facing guides and training material accurate as the product changes.

**Keep product operations running**

* Coordinate releases: draft release clinical SOPs, write and maintain SOPs for recurring work across product, clinical and operations teams, such as content QA, data requests, bug triage and release checks.
* Support partner onboarding with checklists, test accounts and user acceptance testing.
* Send a regular update on content, data and bug queues, and keep the Jira backlog organized for clinical/operations requests

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 2-4 years in product operations, business operations, analytics or a similar role, ideally in health tech or healthcare.
* Strong SQL and hands-on experience with a BI tool such as QuickSight, Tableau or Looker.
* Experience managing content in a headless CMS, ideally Contentful.
* Experience managing EMR workflows, ideally Athena.
* Experience triaging and documenting bugs in Jira.
* Clear, concise writing: tickets, SOPs and updates that others can act on without a meeting.
* Ability to explain a technical product to non-technical clinical colleagues, and to turn their needs into clear requests for engineers.
* A careful, organized approach, and comfort working with sensitive health data under HIPAA.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Content modeling experience in Contentful.
* Experience writing SOPs or training material in a clinical or regulated environment.
* Familiarity with Amazon Redshift and dbt.
* Background in telemedicine, pha

jobs.description:
Who We Are

**Our mission is simple but critical: to build pathways for adult learners to earn high-quality, workforce-aligned degrees and credentials from North Carolina’s public universities.**

**At Project Kitty Hawk, our work reflects our company values:**

**Collaboration** – We prioritize our partners’ success and reputation, aligning every initiative with their goals, reflecting their values, and enhancing their impact.

**Innovation** – We innovate, not replicate. As creative problem solvers, we use data-driven insights to push boundaries, continuously improve our services, develop solutions, and redefine what it means to serve nontraditional learners.

**Empathy** – We understand the unique challenges of nontraditional learners, and are committed to supporting them with empathy, respect, and solutions that fit their needs.

**Integrity** – We operate with transparency and accountability in everything we do. We uphold honesty, take ownership of our work, and maintain the highest standards.

**Teamwork** – We embody the collaboration we seek. We always strive to be dependable, supportive, and solutions-oriented teammates.

Together, we partner with universities in the University of North Carolina (UNC) System to produce innovative, flexible degree and credential programs in high-demand fields. Each PKH team member plays a vital role in advancing this mission and shaping the future of education for adult learners.

These values will enable us to realize PKH’s vision: to make North Carolina’s public universities the top choice for adult learners and to amplify the UNC System’s role as a national leader in higher education innovation, access, and student success. By joining our team, you have an opportunity to contribute to our achievement of that vision, in the process helping to create opportunities for thousands of learners to earn their success and move up the economic ladder.

At Project Kitty Hawk we hire talented people who are not only dedicated to our mission but share our belief that working together makes us stronger and more effective. In this organization you’ll find individuals with a range of interesting backgrounds and life stories; the true magic happens when those individuals come together to solve problems in service of a common goal.

### **The Role**

The Re-Enrollment Specialist (RES) is the primary point of contact for students who have stopped out before completing a degree and want to complete their degree at a UNC System institution. The RES leads the outreach to students, including calling contacts and prioritized segments, understanding the challenges students encountered before stopping out and what stands in the way of returning, and guiding them to the right readmission pathway at the appropriate UNC System institution.

### **What you'll do:**

* Execute high-volume outbound contact (call, text, email) to stopped-out students, prioritizing campaign responders and assigned segments in alignment with established cadences and content guidelines.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand each student’s reasons for stopping out, current goals, and barriers to return.
* Guide students through their next step, from selecting a pathway to starting the readmission or re-entry application, and confirm a warm handoff to the appropriate campus contact.
* Manage a personal pipeline in the CRM (Education Cloud), maintaining accurate dispositions, campus of origin and destination, and next actions.
* Monitor individual metrics, including contact rate, conversations, application starts, and campus handoffs, and take corrective action to improve results.
* Conduct long-term nurturing follow-up to student completers to gather information on student experience, success, and retention
* Develop and maintain working knowledge of the readmission policies, processes, and deadlines of each participating UNC System institution, including readmission versus new-application rules, time-away thresholds, academic standing and suspension requirements, holds, and transfer-credit considerations.
* Use the Re-Enrollment campus knowledge base to identify the correct pathway for each student’s situation and set accurate expectations about requirements and timelines.
* Apply System and campus operating rules on where a student may return (e.g., home-campus-first) and escalate exceptions or unclear cases to the REM.
* Capture structured, consistent data on stop-out reasons, barriers, and outcomes so the program can segment, prioritize, and report accurately.
* Share regular feedback with the REM on messaging performance, list and data quality, and recurring student objections to inform campaign and cadence adjustments.
* Flag policy changes, process friction, and discrepancies between published campus policy and student experience, and contribute updates to the knowledge base and team playbooks.
* Close the loop with campus partners on handoffs, confirming receipt and tracking returned outcomes to identify where students stall after reconnection.
* Partner with the REM and campus re-enrollment, registrar, and admissions contacts to resolve student questions and smooth the path back.
* Collaborate with PKH Marketing, Operations, and Analytics teams on campaign timing, list updates, and reporting.
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all student records and CRM data in the RES’s personal pipeline.

### **What you bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 1+ years of experience in higher education admissions, advising, re-enrollment, or student recruitment, OR equivalent experience in high-volume outbound outreach or customer success.
* Preferred: Experience with readmission or registrar processes, adult and “some college, no credential” learners, or the UNC System.
* Comfort and consistency with high-volume outbound calling, including persistence and resilience with cold and re-engagement outreach.
* Ability to learn, compare, and accurately apply differing policies

**Who Is Marcus Thomas?**
-------------------------

Marcus Thomas is one of the country's leading independent advertising and marketing agencies, and we're independent again on purpose. We bought ourselves back from private equity so our clients and our people come before shareholders. We're 200+ people who work with fewer layers and less bureaucracy, focused on one goal: turning chaos into clarity, built around each client's problem.

We do the work ourselves, with real judgment and real people. We roll up our sleeves, ask a better question, figure it out, and stay in it for the long term. Offices in Cleveland and Cincinnati, Ohio; Buenos Aires, Argentina; and Santiago, Chile, working across creative, media, public relations, social, digital strategy and technology.

---------------------------------

Local candidates are preferred for this role.

* **Cleveland:** Employees in the Cleveland area work from the Cleveland office each Wednesday and one additional day per week based on team needs.
* **Cincinnati:** Employees in the Cincinnati area work from the Cincinnati office each Wednesday and one additional day per week based on team needs.
* **Remote:** Employees elsewhere in Ohio or in an approved state may work remotely.

Candidates must have an established primary residence in an approved state before an offer can be issued. We can’t issue an offer based on a planned future move without a valid address.

**Employment Eligibility**
--------------------------

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Marcus Thomas is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future.

**About the Role**
------------------

Marcus Thomas is seeking an experienced Account Management Supervisor to lead large, high-profile integrated medical technology clients . You'll own the strategic client partnership, guiding senior client leaders through well-informed marketing communications strategies and creative work in a highly regulated healthcare category. Deep healthcare or MedTech experience is essential to this role, because you'll be counseling the client on how to reach patients and healthcare professionals with work that is effective and compliant. This is a leadership-track role within Account Management, where you'll lead and develop account teams while driving organic growth for the business. It's an opportunity to shape work that helps people live healthier lives, at an agency where average client tenure is more than 12 years.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead the strategic relationship with a high-profile medical technology client, guiding integrated marketing communications strategy and creative work from brief through execution.
* Apply healthcare and MedTech category expertise to client challenges, including marketing to patient and healthcare professional (HCP) audiences within regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Partner with client medical, legal and regulatory (MLR) review teams to keep work compliant, on schedule and on strategy.
* Drive progress against client growth goals and identify opportunities for new revenue streams.
* Act as a trusted advisor, providing counsel to client leadership on strategic challenges.

* Lead cross-collaborative teams across web and app, social and traditional channels (TV, print, radio).
* Educate and coach junior and mid-level staff across Communities of Practice, contributing to their growth and success.
* Support broader agency new business efforts with relevant healthcare and MedTech category expertise.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Establish relationships with key client stakeholders and the internal cross-functional team.
* Assess account health, team structure and scope, and share an initial point of view with agency leadership.

**Within 6 Months**
-------------------

* Independently lead the client relationship and be viewed as a trusted advisor by the client and internal team.
* Consistently move integrated work through MLR review on time, on scope and on budget.
* Identify and bring forward organic growth opportunities for the account.

**Within 12 Months**

* Build a stronger, well-developed account team and contribute healthcare category expertise to agency new business.

* 8 to 12 years of proven experience, primarily in integrated advertising agency roles.

### 

### **About Chinese for Affirmative Action (CAA)**

CAA was founded in 1969 to protect the civil and political rights of Chinese Americans and to advance multiracial democracy in the United States. Today, CAA is a progressive voice in and on behalf of the broader Asian American and Pacific Islander community. CAA advocates for systemic change that protects immigrant rights, promotes language diversity, and remedies racial and social injustice.

### 

### **About SF Rapid Response Network (SFRRN)**

The San Francisco Rapid Response Network (SFRRN) is a 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, immigration enforcement response hotline serving the City of San Francisco. Founded in 2008, and revamped in 2016, SFRRN was one of the first, and remains one of the few 24/7 immigration enforcement response hotlines in the country. SFRRN houses 8 immigration focused community based organizations who staff the 24/7 hotline, verifies immigration enforcement activity in San Francisco, connects San Franciscans to legal and accompaniment services, and provides immigration centered Know-Your-Rights education to immigrant community members citywide.

  

In 2026, CAA became the lead and fiscal agency to house the San Francisco Immigrant Legal & Education Network (SFILEN) and SFRRN. As a founding and active member of these networks, CAA is committed to the health and wellbeing of both collaboratives in order that partners may continue to serve immigrant communities with immigration legal services and community education in the face of heightened immigration enforcement and rising xenophobia.

Working under the general direction of the Director of Litigation Support & eDiscovery, the Project Manager serves as the primary operational lead for assigned matters and partners with attorneys, litigation support professionals, review teams, clients, and external service providers to deliver efficient, accurate, and defensible discovery solutions. The role applies advanced eDiscovery expertise and independent judgment to manage competing priorities, identify and mitigate project risks, recommend technical approaches, and maintain accountability for project outcomes.

The Project Manager operates with significant autonomy in the execution of assigned matters while escalating substantive legal decisions and significant strategic, financial, staffing, technology-investment, or departmental matters to the Director or responsible case team.

At Beveridge & Diamond, we do not just practice environmental law—we define it. With more than 170 lawyers across seven U.S. offices and a legacy spanning five decades, we are The Environmental Law Firm. We combine the sophistication and reach of larger firms with the focus and agility of a boutique, counseling the world’s largest companies, industry associations, and municipalities on complex and rapidly evolving environmental issues.

**Responsibilities**

**Project Management and Execution**

* Develop, implement, and maintain project plans for assigned eDiscovery matters, including scope, schedules, milestones, resource requirements, dependencies, quality requirements, and deliverables.
* Manage daily project activities across the discovery lifecycle, from initial planning, preservation, and data collection through processing, review, production, and project closeout.
* Coordinate assignments and workflow sequencing among litigation support analysts, attorneys, review teams, clients, and external vendors.
* Monitor project progress, identify potential delays or resource constraints, and implement corrective actions within established authority.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects while ensuring compliance with established deadlines, requirements, and quality standards.

**eDiscovery Workflow and Technical Coordination**

* Design and coordinate discovery workflows based on matter requirements, data characteristics, and case-team objectives.
* Coordinate preservation and collection activities under attorney direction, including custodians, data sources, collection status, secure transfers, chain-of-custody documentation, and identification of gaps requiring follow-up.
* Translate attorney-approved discovery requirements into processing and production specifications and work with technical personnel and vendors to confirm data completeness, metadata accuracy, document relationships, and resolution of processing exceptions.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate use of eDiscovery tools, search methods, early case assessment, analytics, technology-assisted review, and related technologies.
* Support implementation and validation of AI-enabled discovery workflows, including data preparation, issue-prompt refinement, workflow configuration, pilot testing, sampling, quality control, and documentation, in coordination with the Director and case team.
* Coordinate technical troubleshooting and resolution of workflow issues.

**Budget and Resource Management**

* Prepare project cost estimates and budgets based on anticipated scope, data volumes, staffing, hosting, and vendor requirements.
* Monitor project expenditures, resource utilization, and progress against approved budgets.
* Identify and communicate potential budget variances, cost implications, and opportunities for improved efficiency.
* Coordinate vendor resources, services, and deliverables to support project objectives.
* Maintain accurate project records to support billing, cost recovery, and financial reporting.

**Quality Assurance and Risk Management**

* Establish and oversee project-level quality assurance procedures for data processing, review workflows, and productions.
* Perform or coordinate production quality control, including checks of production scope, redactions, privilege exclusions, metadata, load files, and output specifications; resolve discrepancies and obtain required approvals before release.

**Job Quality:**

***Join a Company That Makes Culture a Priority.***  
  
Rivel is currently seeking a talented, self-assured **Senior Operations Manager, Research Field Services** to join our **Corporate Research** division in a fully remote or hybrid capacity, if local to Westport, CT.  
  
**About Us**  
Rivel is one of the world's largest providers of investor perception studies and a trusted strategic advisor to public company leaders. For more than 35 years, we have helped management teams and boards strengthen investor confidence through research-driven insights, Investor Day strategy, messaging development, governance advisory and sustainability-related counsel. Our proprietary normative database and deep understanding of the investment community enables clients to make more informed decisions and communicate with greater credibility.  
  
**About You**  
You are a proactive, highly organized manager who thrives in a fast-paced environment and approaches priorities with urgency and sound judgment. You communicate clearly, respond promptly and confidently manage competing demands. Success in this role requires a strong, credible leadership presence; the ability to set clear expectations, provide decisive direction, develop others and ensure consistent follow-through; and the confidence to speak up, address issues and drive action when circumstances demand it. This is a hands-on role: you are equally comfortable leading the team as you are stepping directly into day-to-day fieldwork, troubleshooting and executing operations tasks when needed. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented and committed to supporting efficient research operations and data integrity.  
  
**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead field services operations across active studies, including study activation, ongoing fieldwork and interviewer coverage, ensuring timely execution and proactive resolution of field challenges
* Manage assigned research operations teams and coordinate external resources, setting clear expectations and priorities, monitoring quality and performance, providing coaching and feedback, and ensuring accountability and consistent follow-through
* Recruit and onboard field resources based on capacity needs, providing ongoing guidance and support
* Maintain accurate field databases, ensuring compliance with applicable privacy requirements
* Identify and implement improvements to field processes, workflows, tools and overall efficiency
* Conduct interviews as needed to maintain field coverage during capacity constraints

  
**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s degree; experience in market research/data analysis and/or finance a plus
* 3+ years of people-management experience
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and data quality
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, workflows or operational priorities
* Demonstrated ability to identify issues proactively, troubleshoot problems and drive them to resolution with a sense of urgency and sound judgment
* Experience coordinating or leading teams in a deadline-driven environment
* Professional interviewing experience, particularly within market research, financial services or investor research, a plus
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong organizational skills, sound judgment and ability to work independently and take initiative
* Proficiency with MS Word & Excel (intermediate to advanced Excel skills preferred)
* Alignment with Rivel’s core values

  
The base range of compensation for this role is $85,000 - $95,000. Compensation for this position is adjusted based on skill, effort, responsibility, education, training, credentials, geographic location, working conditions and/or experience.

**What you'll do**

* Own campaign operations across Marketo, Salesforce, and connected digital channels
* Manage lead scoring, segmentation, routing, and lifecycle stage logic
* Build and maintain reporting dashboards and campaign performance benchmarks
* Conduct UAT and troubleshoot issues across integrated platforms
* Partner cross-functionally with sales, product, and RevOps on campaign execution and data integrity
* Improve and document scalable marketing operations processes

**What you'll bring**

* 3+ years in marketing operations, revenue operations, or a comparable systems role
* Hands-on proficiency with a marketing automation platform (Marketo preferred) and a CRM (Salesforce preferred)

* Ability to translate technical detail into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders
* Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent hands-on experience and certifications

new_jobs.description:
People Development accelerates the performance of every Metamate, team, and leader — building the capabilities, culture, and human-AI partnerships that power Meta's future. We help people thrive through continuous change, grow more valuable over time, and choose to stay. We do this through coaching, team development, leadership experiences, performance systems, and skills at scale — all working as an integrated system, not a set of disconnected programs.This individual contributor role sits on the Executive Development team, which delivers best-in-class development to Meta's senior most leaders as they forge the future at a transformational moment in the company's history. You will be responsible for the delivery, execution and operations of Executive Development experiences, ensuring the work we do addresses real needs, is targeted, and makes a real difference to our leaders and the business.  
  
  

### **Program Manager, Executive Development Responsibilities:**

* Own the delivery of Executive Development programs. Serve as the participant-facing program manager once a cohort is running, including in-session presence, cohort communications, and holding the experience standard live.
* Own in-person and virtual event execution: venues, vendors, production, print and delivery, and day-of execution — so logistics are invisible to leaders.
* Produce the materials senior leader experiences depend on — briefs, run-of-show documents, journals, and participant materials — to a consistent standard against real deadlines, in place early enough that senior leader and faculty time is immediately productive.
* Drive participants to a filled, ready cohort. Issue invitations, track nominations, confirmations and declines, chase non-responses through executive assistants, and drive required inputs — assessments, pre-work, forms, and closeout surveys — to completion, documenting exceptions.
* Build the repeatable processes behind each program, documented well enough that someone new could run it, and keep program assets current, findable, and reusable cycle over cycle — so delivery never depends on who is staffed.
* Own data capture and standing reporting. Capture data at the right moments in each program and maintain the reporting and quality checks built on it.
* Project-manage design and build work toward execution — workback plans, designer and vendor coordination, decision-gate readiness, and asset production.
* Manage contingent workers and vendors against a clear brief, holding delivery quality and timelines.
* Execute communications plans — drafting, sequencing, scheduling, sending, and tracking.
* Apply AI to how the team operates — automating and compressing internal workflows, reporting, tracking, and production, including completing privacy and sensitivity review.
* Support planning with delivery evidence. Bring participant and program data into quarterly planning, maintain team meeting materials and trackers, and surface delivery risk early.
* Jump in and manage evolving priorities, including planning and executing special projects and events as needed.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years experience developing and executing business and/or learning solutions
* 4+ years of program/project management experience running programs end to end
* Demonstrated track record of delivering high-touch programs or events for senior or executive audiences, where quality and discretion are non-negotiable
* Demonstrated track record of establishing credibility in front of senior leaders — able to hold a room of executives during delivery, read it, and adjust in the moment
* Demonstrated track record of building and maintaining trackers, operating procedures, and reporting that others rely on
* Demonstrated track record of attention to detail in participant-facing materials and communications
* Experience managing complex logistics for in-person and virtual experiences, including vendors and external suppliers
* Experience applying AI tools to automate or improve operational workflows
* Experience managing, structuring, and analyzing program data
* Experience managing contingent workers or vendors to a defined brief
* Entrepreneurial multi-tasker who can be highly efficient with ambiguity and complexity, and who stays calm when timelines compress

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Event management experience at executive level
* Project Management (PMP / PMI) certification
* Experience supporting executive assistants or executive offices
* Data analysis acumen
* Bachelor's Degree

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. * Help improve project tracking and coordination practices as the NBA platform continues to grow.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing projects involving multiple business and technology stakeholders.
* Experience developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, schedules, dependencies, risks, and issues.
* Experience coordinating activities across Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Testing, or other delivery organizations.
* Experience working within Agile or Scrum software development environments.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and priorities.
* Experience preparing project status reporting and communicating delivery progress to stakeholders and leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to identify, track, and communicate risks, issues, dependencies, and schedule impacts.
* Strong facilitation and coordination skills with the ability to work effectively across matrixed teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience supporting customer engagement, marketing technology, personalization, decisioning, or customer experience platforms.
* Experience working in healthcare, health insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated industry.

new_jobs.description:
Case Manager – Social Security Disability Claims

Oct 26, 2026 · @Karl

**Disability Specialists · Cook, MN or remote · $50,000–$60,000 a year**

Why this job matters

Most people who apply for Social Security disability are already going through one of the hardest stretches of their lives. They're out of work, managing a health condition, and facing a federal process with long waits, strict deadlines, and a lot of paperwork. Many are denied the first time and don't realize they can appeal.

That's where we come in. Disability Specialists represents people through SSDI and SSI claims, from the first application through appeal. As our Case Manager, you'll keep each client's claim moving: you'll know where it stands, what it still needs, and what comes next, and you'll make sure the client knows too.

The role

You'll manage a caseload of claims at different stages, working with clients, Social Security field and hearing offices, and medical providers. The job is part paperwork, part detective work, and part customer care. A good day ends with a complete file, a deadline met, and a client who feels less alone in the process.

Your work at each stage of a claim

Stage

What you'll do

**Intake**

Schedule intake appointments and send reminder letters. Handle intakes for new and returning clients when needed, and make first contact with each new client by phone or letter.

**Representation and billing**

Receive and process representation paperwork. Enter charges from the first client conference and from hearings in Prevail, our case management software.

**Working the claim with SSA**

Process paperwork from Social Security and run regular status checks. Keep each client's medical, address, and phone information current, and submit updates when needed. Check claims for quality and accuracy before they go out.

**Denials and appeals**

Process denials at every level, including decisions from Administrative Law Judges and the Appeals Council. Write "good cause" requests when a deadline was missed for a valid reason.

**Hearing level**

Complete pre-hearing forms and review exhibit files. Submit on-the-record requests, dire need requests, and stipulations.

**Appeals Council and federal court**

File Appeals Council appeals and track their status. Set up client calls and appointments when a case moves to the Appeals Council or federal court. When an Appeals Council case ends, close the file and start a new claim if the client needs one.

**Closing files**

Close finished files and withdraw applications or hearing requests when needed. Handle the files of clients who have passed away with care.

**Every day**

* Answer incoming calls from Social Security, hearing offices, and the Appeals Council
* Sort mail, email, and faxes from clients and hearing offices, and route each one to the right person
* Work closely with our representatives and support staff
* Help with other tasks as needed

Who thrives in this role

* **You're organized by nature.** You can keep many open files straight, and you notice when something is missing.
* **You write and speak clearly.** You can explain a confusing letter from Social Security to a worried client, then fill out a precise form for a government reviewer.
* **You stay patient and kind under pressure.** Clients may be in pain, frustrated, or scared. You stay steady and respectful.
* **You follow through.** A records request isn't done when it's sent. It's done when the records arrive.
* **You manage your own time well.** You can plan your day and set priorities without someone checking in, which matters even more if you work remotely.
* **You're comfortable with technology.** You use standard office software easily and can learn a case management system quickly.

**Helpful, but not required:**

* Experience with Prevail case management software
* Knowledge of SSDI and SSI rules and procedures
* A background in social services, healthcare, legal support, insurance claims, or customer service

New to disability claims? If the rest of this sounds like you, we'd still like to hear from you.

Pay and benefits

* **Salary:** $48,000–$60,000, based on experience
* **2 weeks paid vacation** starting your first year
* **24 hours of additional PTO**
* **IRA with [3]% employer match**
* **Health care stipend**
* **Flexibility:** Work from our Cook, MN office or remotely, for qualified candidates
* **Work with a clear purpose:** every finished file moves someone closer to the support they need

Pay: $48,000.00 - $60,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Life insurance
* Paid training
* Parental leave

new_jobs.title: Case Manager
new_jobs.description:
Case Manager – Social Security Disability Claims

Oct 26, 2026 · @Karl

**Disability Specialists · Cook, MN or remote · $50,000–$60,000 a year**

Why this job matters

Most people who apply for Social Security disability are already going through one of the hardest stretches of their lives. They're out of work, managing a health condition, and facing a federal process with long waits, strict deadlines, and a lot of paperwork. Many are denied the first time and don't realize they can appeal.

That's where we come in. Disability Specialists represents people through SSDI and SSI claims, from the first application through appeal. As our Case Manager, you'll keep each client's claim moving: you'll know where it stands, what it still needs, and what comes next, and you'll make sure the client knows too.

The role

You'll manage a caseload of claims at different stages, working with clients, Social Security field and hearing offices, and medical providers. The job is part paperwork, part detective work, and part customer care. A good day ends with a complete file, a deadline met, and a client who feels less alone in the process.

Your work at each stage of a claim

Stage

What you'll do

**Intake**

Schedule intake appointments and send reminder letters. Handle intakes for new and returning clients when needed, and make first contact with each new client by phone or letter.

**Representation and billing**

Receive and process representation paperwork. Enter charges from the first client conference and from hearings in Prevail, our case management software.

**Working the claim with SSA**

Process paperwork from Social Security and run regular status checks. Keep each client's medical, address, and phone information current, and submit updates when needed. Check claims for quality and accuracy before they go out.

**Denials and appeals**

Process denials at every level, including decisions from Administrative Law Judges and the Appeals Council. Write "good cause" requests when a deadline was missed for a valid reason.

**Hearing level**

Complete pre-hearing forms and review exhibit files. Submit on-the-record requests, dire need requests, and stipulations.

**Appeals Council and federal court**

File Appeals Council appeals and track their status. Set up client calls and appointments when a case moves to the Appeals Council or federal court. When an Appeals Council case ends, close the file and start a new claim if the client needs one.

**Closing files**

Close finished files and withdraw applications or hearing requests when needed. Handle the files of clients who have passed away with care.

**Every day**

* Answer incoming calls from Social Security, hearing offices, and the Appeals Council
* Sort mail, email, and faxes from clients and hearing offices, and route each one to the right person
* Work closely with our representatives and support staff
* Help with other tasks as needed

Who thrives in this role

* **You're organized by nature.** You can keep many open files straight, and you notice when something is missing.
* **You write and speak clearly.** You can explain a confusing letter from Social Security to a worried client, then fill out a precise form for a government reviewer.
* **You stay patient and kind under pressure.** Clients may be in pain, frustrated, or scared. You stay steady and respectful.
* **You follow through.** A records request isn't done when it's sent. It's done when the records arrive.
* **You manage your own time well.** You can plan your day and set priorities without someone checking in, which matters even more if you work remotely.
* **You're comfortable with technology.** You use standard office software easily and can learn a case management system quickly.

**Helpful, but not required:**

* Experience with Prevail case management software
* Knowledge of SSDI and SSI rules and procedures
* A background in social services, healthcare, legal support, insurance claims, or customer service

New to disability claims? If the rest of this sounds like you, we'd still like to hear from you.

Pay and benefits

* **Salary:** $48,000–$60,000, based on experience
* **2 weeks paid vacation** starting your first year
* **24 hours of additional PTO**
* **IRA with [3]% employer match**
* **Health care stipend**
* **Flexibility:** Work from our Cook, MN office or remotely, for qualified candidates
* **Work with a clear purpose:** every finished file moves someone closer to the support they need

Pay: $48,000.00 - $60,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Life insurance
* Paid training
* Parental leave

Work Location: Remote
